We strive to empower residents of affordable housing communities through our onsite services, aiming to create pathways for self\-reliance and personal growth.  

  

Join the Project Access team and create impact in the lives of our residents. Hear from them and how their lives have changed: www.project\-access.org/success\-stories/ **The opportunity**
The Resident Services Coordinator designs and implements programs that enhance community life for residents of all ages. They serve as a vital link between residents and services, creating value through targeted initiatives that address community needs. This role requires an innovative, proactive individual who excels in an autonomous environment, driving positive long\-term outcomes through an understanding of the communities in which they serve. **What you'll do*** Implement core programs and services, which include connecting, engaging, and empowering residents across four initiatives: Economic Stability, Education for Youth \& Families, Health \& Wellness, and Community Building.

* Plan \& facilitate community\-building events that foster safe and meaningful relationships between community members.

* Use personal automobile to acquire program supplies and donations and attend offsite meetings (mileage reimbursed at IRS rate).

jobs.title: Logistics Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

POVISON is seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive Logistics Operations Coordinator to support our U.S. logistics operations, with a primary focus on Direct\-to\-Consumer (DTC), final\-mile, and white\-glove delivery performance.

Fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English is **REQUIRED** for this position due to regular communication and coordination with POVISON's China\-based team.

This role is responsible for monitoring shipments from warehouse dispatch through final delivery, coordinating with warehouses and carriers, proactively identifying transportation risks, resolving delivery exceptions, and supporting successful delivery execution.

The Logistics Operations Coordinator will work closely with U.S. Operations, warehouses, carriers, finalmile delivery teams, internal support teams, and POVISON's China\-based team to ensure issues are identified early and driven through resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and monitor the end\-to\-end post\-shipment process for DTC orders, from warehouse dispatch through successful final delivery.
* Track shipment and delivery status throughout the transportation process and maintain visibility of open or at\-risk orders.
* Monitor warehouse and carrier exceptions in real time, including pickup delays, transit delays, prolonged tracking inactivity, damaged shipments, lost shipments, and delivery failures.
* Proactively identify orders at risk of becoming service exceptions based on shipment milestones, tracking activity, historical trends, and carrier performance.
* Take preventive action by communicating with warehouses, carriers, final\-mile providers, and internal teams before issues escalate.
* Coordinate POVISON's final\-mile and white\-glove home delivery operations, including delivery scheduling, access concerns, address issues, product questions, reschedules, returns, and delivery exceptions.
* Manage transportation and delivery exceptions including damaged or missing products, customer refusals, unable\-to\-fit situations, incomplete deliveries, unsuccessful delivery attempts, and assembly or installation concerns.
* Ensure appropriate photos, notes, tracking information, and supporting documentation are collected when necessary.
* Maintain ownership of open exceptions and drive issues toward resolution while providing timely updates to the appropriate teams.
* Respond to logistics\-related requests including address changes, expedited delivery requests, shipment intercepts, and other delivery needs.
* Communicate and coordinate regularly with POVISON's China\-based team in Mandarin and English regarding shipment status, inventory questions, product concerns, damages, delivery exceptions, and issue resolution.
* Utilize shipment tracking data and carrier performance information to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for operational improvement.
* Maintain accurate logistics records and provide Operations leadership with visibility into shipment performance, delivery issues, and unresolved exceptions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Fluent in Mandarin Chinese and English – REQUIRED
* Bachelor's degree or above.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in both Mandarin and English.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, and commonly used formulas/ functions.
* Ability to independently draft professional business communications regarding shipment exceptions, logistics inquiries, carrier issues, and delivery updates.
* Strong analytical, logical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify potential risks from shipment tracking data and operational trends.
* Proactive approach to problem\-solving with a strong sense of urgency, ownership, and accountability.
* Ability to manage multiple shipments and exception cases simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong cross\-functional coordination skills with the ability to work effectively with warehouses, carriers, delivery teams, internal departments, and international teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Degree in Logistics Management, Supply Chain, Statistics, Accounting, E\-Commerce, Business, or a related field.
* Previous experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, e\-commerce, or final\-mile delivery.
* Experience in cross\-border e\-commerce or Direct\-to\-Consumer (DTC) operations.
* Experience with furniture, home delivery, or white\-glove final\-mile delivery.
* Experience working directly with warehouses, carriers, and international teams.

jobs.description:
**OVERVIEW**



The Los Angeles Football Club (LAFC) is an MLS soccer club serving the greater Los Angeles area. LAFC is dedicated to building a world\-class soccer club that represents the diversity of Los Angeles and is committed to delivering an unrivaled experience for fans. LAFC's ownership group is comprised of local leaders and innovators of industry with intellectual capital, financial prowess, operations expertise, and success in the fields of entertainment, sports, technology, and media. LAFC is invested in the world's game and Los Angeles, constructing, and developing the 22,000 seat BMO Stadium and a top\-flight training center on the campus of Cal\-State Los Angeles.

**POSITION SUMMARY**



The Coordinator, Event Operations is responsible for assisting in general tasks required to run, maintain, and service the stadium and/or events. This position will also act as a liaison between the facility and clients, ensuring all clients' requirements are met, and facility rules, regulations, and policies are adhered to.



This role will be expected to work approximately 20% of the time overnight but may be subject to change depending on business needs.



This role reports to the Manager, Event Operations.


**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**


* Coordinate and ensure completion of maintenance and repairs received from stadium Operations leadership.
* Contribute to training and coordinating part\-time operations crew in the completion of general tasks to service the stadium and/or events.
* Coordinate and facilitate operations related requirements and requests from various departments and contractors to ensure the facility is ready for each event.
* Support the installation and dismantle of various conversion equipment, including but not limited to, staging, temporary flooring, trussing, demountable seating, and chair set/strike.
* Regularly attend event planning meetings to ensure the Operations Department receives pertinent information to appropriate staff and prepare the facility for upcoming events.
* Partner with all applicable departments to provide clear, concise, and timely communications regarding event requirements and requests.
* Assist the department in tracking and accounting for inventory and all stadium equipment on a regular basis.
* Conduct periodic facility walk throughs to identify maintenance issues and provide solutions.
* Assist with the development and implementation of preventative maintenance schedules, departmental standard operating procedures, emergency procedures, and risk/safety policies are being adhered to and compliant with all governmental regulations including but not limited to Cal/OSHA.
* Other duties as assigned by Supervisor/Management.


**QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Facilities Management, or related field from an accredited College or University preferred, or an equivalent combination of 3 – 5 years of training, experience, and education.
* Minimum of 1\-2 years' experience in arena or stadium operations required, preferably at a high\-volume location.
* Working knowledge of practices and procedures related to events, facility conversion, and maintenance of equipment.
* Ability to understand and work from general instructions, specifications, blueprints, sketches, event documents, and preventative maintenance schedules.
* Ability to build and maintain working relationships with peers, clients, exhibitors, patrons, and others encountered throughout the course of employment.
* Detail oriented with an ability to multi\-task and meet strict deadlines.
* Strong communication skills – both written and verbal.
* Working knowledge of Google Workplace and Microsoft Office Suite programs.
* Must be able to work flexible hours including nights, overnights, weekends, and holidays as needed.
* Must be able to lift up to 50lbs without assistance and stand/walk for long period of time.
* Must possess a current and valid California Driver's License.
* Current forklift and/or scissor lift certification is preferred.
* Bilingual in Spanish is a plus.


**SALARY RANGE**



At LAFC, we carefully consider a wide range of factors to determine a fair and equitable compensation package. The final offer amount will consider a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to skill sets; relevant experience and training. Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure guidelines, the compensation for this role is $26\.00 per hour.

**Overview:**

Join Ashley Ravid Group (ARG), a growing educational therapy practice where relationships matter just as much as results. We support students of all ages with learning differences, helping them close learning gaps, build confidence, and reach their full potential. We see the whole child and believe meaningful progress happens when students feel supported socially, emotionally, and academically.

Our team is made up of dedicated professionals with specialized training in evidence\-based programs and approaches designed to help students become confident, successful learners. We are passionate about what we do—and equally passionate about creating a warm, supportive experience for the families we serve.

jobs.title: Experienced Clinical Research Coordinator - Long Beach
jobs.description:
Healthy Brain Clinic in Long Beach, CA is part of the Irvine Clinical Research site network, the largest of its kind on the West Coast. With 5 research centers in California, we are leaders in the search for new treatments in neurology, psychiatry, and obesity medicine. Our largest area of research is in Alzheimer’s Disease prevention and treatment drug trials, and our doctors were the largest contributors in the world to the most recently FDA\-approved medication in Alzheimer’s Disease.

We are seeking a dedicated and experienced **Clinical Research Coordinator** to drive trial success at our Long Beach location. This role is ideal for a seasoned CRC (internally leveled as a CRC II, III, or IV depending on experience) who is ready to take ownership of complex Phase II and III clinical trials. You will work closely with our Principal Investigators and clinical team to ensure the highest standards of data integrity, patient safety, and operational excellence.
### **Job Duties**

* **Study Management:** Serve as the primary or co\-coordinator for assigned Phase II/III clinical research studies, overseeing day\-to\-day operations from site initiation to closeout.
* **Protocol Compliance:** Execute study procedures with strict adherence to Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines, FDA regulations, and specific study protocols.
* **Patient Coordination:** Guide participants through complex visit schedules, including consenting, screening, and coordinating cross\-functional appointments (e.g., imaging, infusions).
* **Data Integrity:** Timely and accurately enter, organize, and maintain study data across various electronic platforms (eSource, EDC, CTMS), proactively resolving queries.
* **Clinical Assessments:** Conduct vital signs, ECGs, and other protocol\-specific diagnostic, efficacy, and safety assessments.
* **Quality \& Audit Readiness:** Maintain impeccable regulatory and source documentation, ensuring the site is consistently prepared for sponsor monitoring visits and audits.

### **Job Requirements**

* **Experience:** 2 to 4\+ years of hands\-on experience coordinating industry\-sponsored clinical trials (prior experience in CNS, Neurology, or Psychiatry is a strong plus).
* **Technical Skills:** Demonstrated ability to navigate complex clinical trial management systems (CRIO eSource \& CTMS) and EDC platforms quickly and accurately.
* **Organization \& Precision:** Exceptional attention to detail, capable of managing competing priorities and complex visit windows without compromising quality.
* **Communication:** A strong, professional command of spoken and written English, with a proven ability to build rapport with older adult populations and their study partners.

**Hours and Compensation**
* **Location:** This is a full\-time employment position based in\-person at our Healthy Brain Clinic / Long Beach site in Long Beach: 1703 Termino Ave, Ste 201, Long Beach, CA 90804
* **Compensation:** The expected salary range for this position is **$30\-40 per hour** (**$62,400 to $83,200 per year**). *Final compensation offers will be determined based on the candidate's specific internal level (CRC II \- IV), years of relevant clinical trial experience, and applicable clinical certifications (e.g., CCRC, nursing, or phlebotomy license).*
* **Insurance:** The company covers 100% of employee\-only premiums for our baseline Gold HMO health plan, plus dental and vision coverage.
* **Paid Time Off:** Vacation (PTO) is earned at a rate of **3 weeks per year**.
**Equal Opportunity \& Fair Chance Employer** *Healthy Brain Clinic and its affiliates are Equal Opportunity Employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**



The Retail Pre\-Production Coordinator is an integral part of Global Merchandises’ supply chain. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in organization, multi\-tasking, self\-management, and strong communication skills. This role is to ensure that Global can efficiently track \& monitor all styles in sampling while setting manageable priorities with our vendors \& internal team to push for timely approvals.



Exceptional critical thinking with the ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple projects with overlapping deadlines is essential for this role. A substantial working knowledge of Microsoft Excel is necessary. The ability to take instruction is paramount, along with the timely management of a varied workload, with pressing deadlines and priorities.



This individual must be highly efficient, dedicated to the task at hand and must be able to communicate effectively, have the tenacity to problem\-solve and work as a team player. This individual submits samples to our licensors for alignment and approval.



This is a critical part of our licensed merchandise process and must be handled quickly and effectively to ensure targets are met. The Pre\-Production Coordinator is responsible for all new development that goes into sampling. Pre\-Production Coordinator must keep track of and communicate any foreseeable production challenges to respective teams and offer solutions.

 **ESSENTIAL DUTIES**


* Work closely with Production Manager, along with sales \& creative, to ensure all samples are executed correctly \& in a timely fashion.
* Create \& maintain all item set ups when sales team requests new items to assign style numbers.
* Handle Purchase Order Form (POF) requests from sales team \& coordinate with creative team to collect art links/SEP files. Push and set priorities internally with creative team for art links/SEP files. Information needs to be organized in the creative tracker \& sample tracker.
* Manage sample inventory, tracking product \& hitting deadlines.
* Working with manufacturers/vendors to resolve issues during the sample process.
* Provide feedback and continued liaison for required revisions/re\-samples with vendors, keeping sales managers \& production team updated throughout process.
* Maintain \& update sample tracker WIP to keep all sampling organized and follow up with vendors in a timely fashion. Manages workflow, prioritizing consistent follow through with factories on proto and pre\-production sampling.
* Set sampling priorities with vendors based on PO’s and desired deliveries.
* Send out weekly WIPS to vendors to push for all updates on sample ETA’s (Estimated time of Arrival) and DDD’s (Drop Dead Date – for approval).
* Share art links/SEP files with allocated vendor after creative distributes to team.
* Collect all sample images from vendors and send off for brand manager/licensor approval upon receipt (time sensitive) after creative signs off.
* Communicate approval comments and corrections to internal and external channels; trackers, factories/vendors, and partners as applicable.
* Coordinate all sample tracking from vendors and ship physical samples to retailers.
* Review sample requests and identify any sampling/production concerns and provide possible solutions. Communicate necessary information to respective teams.
* Brainstorm new processes that promote efficiencies with order ingestion.
* Handle ad\-hoc duties as they arise \& assist with other projects as needed.

* Bachelor’s Degree (Preferred) or equivalent work experience
* Must have the ability to multi\-task and prioritize in a fast\-paced, time\-pressured environment.
* Outstanding verbal \& written communications skills and able to liaise internally with various teams such as production/sales/brand mgmt. and externally with manufacturers/vendors/customers.
* Trained eye for the elements of design: ie. color, proportion, and balance as well as aesthetic detail. Pantone color experience is a plus.
* Ability to self\-manage/work independently, demonstrable leadership and stress management skills.
* Multitask, highly motivated, positive, and strong work and team ethics. Critical thinking with the ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple projects with overlapping deadlines.
* Excellent time management and organizational skills, along with the ability to prioritize and possess a sense of urgency when appropriate.
* Basic knowledge of license apparel a plus.
* Demonstrable experience in a similar role.
* Experience working in timeline driven environments.
* Knowledge and experience using Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator programs.
* Experience in Screen Printing \& Embroidery (Preferred)
* Experience in Microsoft Suite \& Google Suite


**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**


* Ability to sit, stand, and move around the office environment for extended periods.
* Ability to use a computer keyboard and mouse up to 80% of the workday.
* Ability to reach with hands and arms to access files, equipment, and workstations.

* Reviewing design files and pitch deck materials

jobs.title: Service Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
CFT/LDP, a mission‑critical consulting firm and regional representative for Schneider Electric, is seeking a self‑driven **Service Sales Account Manager**. This role focuses exclusively on selling mission\-critical power and cooling service contracts, preventive maintenance, and modernization projects. The ideal candidate combines technical ability with strong commercial drive and excels at building long‑term relationships with engineers, contractors, and facility teams.

**Primary Responsibilities**

New Business Development

* Prospect and qualify new end‑user accounts within the territory.
* Develop service proposals for UPS, ATS, Power Distribution, and cooling equipment.
* Identify and close modernization and lifecycle upgrade opportunities (UPS and cooling refresh, battery replacements, switchgear retrofits).
* Capture and initiate service agreements for UPS and cooling systems approaching the end of their factory warranty or operating with expired contracts.
* Initiate and lead on‑site meetings with newly identified prospects to build rapport, uncover service opportunities, and lay the foundation for long‑term partnerships.

Recurring Business \& Renewals

* Manage service contract renewals and maintain a high level of renewal rate.
* Maintain strong relationships with facilities, electrical and mechanical contractors.
* Establish and maintain a regular schedule of in‑person engagements with key customers to review equipment status, discuss service strategies, and reinforce long‑term partnership value.

Collaboration \& Coordination

* Align with Schneider Electric’s One Services Team for pricing, scoping, and site support.
* Coordinate with CFT/LDP project management and Schneider Electric during new equipment installation handoff.
* Partner with CFT/LDP equipment sales teams to position replacement of aging infrastructure.

Sales Operations

* Maintain accurate pipeline and forecasting within Monday CRM.
* Track regional activity, opportunities, and closed‑won business.
* Meet or exceed assigned service revenue, profit, and renewal targets.

Qualities \& Experience

* Experience in electrical or mechanical service sales, ideally in mission‑critical environments, is preferred but not required.
* Strong consultative selling skills and ability to communicate with facilities teams, engineers, and contractors.
* Self‑motivated, organized, and driven to exceed goals.
* Customer‑service mindset with ability to build trust and long‑term relationships.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.

Job Location \& Travel

* Based on assigned territory.
* Local field travel (25%–50%) for onsite meetings, equipment startup handoffs, and industry events.

Compensation

* Commensurate with experience and performance expectations.

Pay: From $100,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Specialist – Paid Ads, Sales Growth & Livestream Strategy
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Longevity Nutra, Inc. is seeking a **results\-driven, hands\-on Performance Marketing Specialist** to manage paid advertising and help drive measurable, profitable sales growth across our eCommerce business.

Our primary advertising platforms include **Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube**.

This is not a role focused simply on generating clicks, views, or engagement. We are looking for someone who understands how to turn advertising spend into **customer acquisition, sales, revenue, and sustainable growth**.

The ideal candidate can personally manage and optimize paid advertising campaigns while also thinking beyond the ad account — developing ideas for **offers, promotions, sales campaigns, retargeting strategies, livestream campaigns, creative concepts, and customer acquisition strategies** that can improve overall sales performance.

Our current customer base is primarily **Vietnamese\-speaking consumers in the U.S.**, while one of our key growth priorities is expanding into the broader **U.S. consumer market**. The successful candidate will help strengthen sales within our existing market while developing, testing, and scaling strategies to reach new U.S. customers.

**Vietnamese language ability is highly preferred but not required.**

**Primary Objective**

The primary objective of this position is to use paid media and performance marketing to generate **measurable and profitable sales growth**. Success in this role will be evaluated based on business outcomes such as:

* Revenue generated from paid advertising
* ROAS
* CPA / CAC
* Conversion rate
* Customer acquisition volume
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* Campaign profitability
* Ability to successfully test and scale winning campaigns

We value reach, engagement, and traffic when they contribute to the customer journey — but **sales performance and profitable customer acquisition are the ultimate goals.** 

**What You’ll Own**

**Paid Advertising \& Revenue Growth**

* Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across **Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube**
* Take day\-to\-day ownership of campaign performance and advertising budgets
* Drive **profitable online sales and revenue growth** through paid media
* Optimize campaigns for conversions, customer acquisition, revenue, and profitability — not simply traffic or engagement
* Monitor and improve **ROAS, CPA, CAC, conversion rate, AOV, and revenue**
* Identify winning campaigns and scale them responsibly
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and take corrective action
* Allocate advertising budgets based on measurable performance and growth potential

**Sales \& Promotional Strategy**

* Work with management to develop **sales campaigns, promotional offers, bundles, limited\-time promotions, and customer acquisition strategies**
* Use advertising and sales data to recommend offers that may improve conversion and revenue
* Develop campaign strategies around **product launches, promotions, seasonal opportunities, clearance campaigns, and special events**
* Identify opportunities for upselling, cross\-selling, bundles, and retargeting
* Develop strategies for acquiring new customers and re\-engaging previous customers
* Recommend when to scale, modify, pause, or replace campaigns based on results

We want someone who can contribute ideas and say:

**“Here is the audience. Here is the offer. Here is the creative angle. Here is how we should advertise it. Here is how we measure whether it worked.”**

**Livestream \& Social Commerce Strategy**

* Help develop advertising and promotional strategies to support **livestream selling**
* Work with our internal team to create campaigns that drive customers to livestream events
* Develop pre\-live, live, and post\-live advertising strategies
* Recommend livestream offers, bundles, promotions, and calls\-to\-action
* Retarget viewers and engaged audiences after livestream events
* Analyze livestream campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement
* Support the development of **TikTok and Facebook social commerce strategies** as appropriate

**This position is not required to be the on\-camera livestream host.** The focus is on developing and optimizing the marketing and sales strategy behind livestream campaigns.

**Audience \& Market Expansion**

* Develop advertising strategies for both **Vietnamese\-speaking and broader U.S. consumer audiences**
* Strengthen customer acquisition within our existing Vietnamese\-speaking market
* Develop and test strategies to expand into the broader U.S. market
* Build prospecting, retargeting, lookalike, and audience segmentation strategies
* Adapt creative concepts, messaging, offers, and targeting based on different consumer audiences
* Identify new audience and market opportunities through campaign data

**Creative Strategy \& Testing**

* Develop structured testing plans for **creative concepts, hooks, messaging, offers, audiences, and ad formats**
* Identify which advertisements and creative elements are generating **sales — and why**
* Translate campaign performance into actionable recommendations for our creative team
* Collaborate with our internal team on **video ads, image ads, short\-form content, promotional creatives, and livestream content**
* Identify winning creatives and develop new testing variations
* Establish a repeatable process for testing and scaling successful advertising concepts

**Analytics, Tracking \& Optimization**

* Monitor campaign tracking, attribution, pixels, and analytics
* Work with **Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Google Ads, YouTube Ads, Google Analytics 4 (GA4\), Google Tag Manager (GTM), and related tools**
* Analyze the full customer journey:

**Ad → Landing Page → Product → Checkout → Sale**

* Determine whether performance issues originate from **media, audience, creative, messaging, offer, pricing, landing page, or conversion funnel**
* Track revenue and customer acquisition performance by campaign
* Provide c

The Head Coach is expected to role model all of the qualities and attributes of an exceptional coach – the Head Coach is expected to coach an average of eleven (11\) classes per week. Responsible for delivering a best in class experience, setting the standards for other coaches to aspire to. The Head Coach provides a high level of coach development, giving consistent feedback to their team with the ability to provide support in\-studio throughout new coach trainings.
### **You will be responsible for:**

* Serving as the \[solidcore] studio’s lead coach, maintaining a full schedule of 11 classes per week.
* Serving as an example and setting the expectations for new and existing coaches.
* Delivering a best\-in\-class fitness and customer service experience consistent with \[solidcore] standards.
* Meeting company utilization \& retention expectations on both an individual level and for the studio as a whole.
* Taking direction from the Area Manager to assist with day\-to\-day operations of the studio.
* Lead outreach and marketing efforts as necessary to scout new clients and create long\-term partnerships in the community.
* Providing coach development to a team of coaches, delivering informal/formal feedback \& assisting new coach trainings with in\-person support.
* Assisting as needed with responses to client requests and resolving concerns promptly and effectively.
* Maintaining product knowledge for all studio retail operations, including class packages, current promotions, and apparel.
* Executing routine operational tasks including, but not limited to ordering supplies, conducting inventory, and maintaining sales logs.
* Ensuring the studio and equipment remain impeccable and fully\-functioning at all times.
* Other duties and projects as assigned and as needed.

### **What we need from you:**

* This is a permanent, exempt, full\-time position with an expected 40 hours per week (including classes coached).
* Flexible and variable availability including weekends \& holidays with ability to accommodate coach training schedules \& the fluctuating needs of the business.
* Ability to lift / carry a minimum of 30 pounds.
* Proficiency in g\-Suite and MS office, specifically excel and google sheets.

### **What skills and experience you will bring to us:**

* Optimism and hard work with a love for health, fitness, and the \[solidcore] workout.
* Passionate about helping others become the strongest version of themselves and achieve their goals.
* Passionate about building relationships and developing teams, creating an environment that fosters growth.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, people\-focused, entrepreneurial environment.
* 1\-2 years prior group fitness experience.
* Outgoing and personable with a desire to build relationships within and outside the \[solidcore] community.
* Team player with a positive attitude.
* Genuine desire to inspire and motivate others.
* Reliable and professional.
* Comfortable on a mic leading a fast\-paced class with loud music and lots of energy in the room.
* Ability to model the \[solidcore] brand and culture and serve as a lead representative of the \[solidcore] community.
* Superior client relations and communication skills.

### **Compensation \& Benefits**

* Compensation Range: $68,004 \- $75,654 per year
* Flexible PTO
* Full coverage health, dental, \& vision insurance
* 401k with employer match
* Cellphone stipend
* And MORE!

\[solidcore] is a national boutique fitness company with 100\+ studios across the country. Our signature workout is 50 minutes of low\-impact, high\-intensity strength training: the lights are low and the music is loud. The coach guides the class through a series of slow \& controlled movements that are sequenced to work muscles to failure. This class is accessible for all fitness levels and can be amplified or modified to accommodate individual goals. Class is as intense as our reviews suggest, but our instructors go above and beyond to provide a welcoming, supportive, empowering, and challenging experience for all. Please visit our website here to read more about our mission.  

\[solidcore] is firmly committed to social justice and promoting a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion. You can click here to find out more about the actions we are taking to promote a more diverse and inclusive space for both our clients and our internal team.  

\[solidcore] is an equal\-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. At SimplePractice, we are improving access to quality care by equipping health and wellness clinicians with all the tools they need to thrive in private practice.



More than 250,000 providers trust SimplePractice to build their business through our industry\-leading software with powerful tools that simplify every part of practice management. **The Role**



We're looking for a strategic, results\-driven Manager of Customer Success to lead our CSM team and drive exceptional outcomes for our group practice customers.



SimplePractice is built for our customers, and supporting their success is our top priority. We strive to provide unparalleled support and encourage our customers to always let us know how we can improve our products.



You'll be a key leader within the Customer Success organization, developing and coaching your team of CSMs while driving customer health, retention, and expansion across our portfolio. This role will give you the opportunity to contribute insights that inform CS strategy, build a high\-performing team, and make a measurable impact on customer outcomes in a dynamic, high\-growth environment.


**Responsibilities**


* Lead and Develop High\-Performing CSM Teams
* Provide strategic oversight and leadership for your team of Customer Success Managers, ensuring alignment with departmental goals and organizational priorities.
* Coach and develop team members through structured 1\-on\-1s, Growth \& Impact Plans, and professional development initiatives that build strategic account management capabilities.
* Design and execute performance improvement strategies that enhance individual and team effectiveness in driving customer health, retention, and expansion.
* Foster a culture of excellence, proactive engagement, and outcome\-based customer success through motivational leadership and values\-driven management.
* Optimize team capacity and coverage models through strategic portfolio planning, workload management, and resource allocation.


**Drive Customer Outcomes and Revenue Impact**


* Own customer health, retention, and expansion metrics for your team's portfolio, ensuring proactive identification and mitigation of churn risk.
* Partner with CSMs to develop and execute strategic account plans that drive product adoption, demonstrate value, and uncover expansion opportunities.
* Implement customer health scoring frameworks and early warning systems that enable proactive intervention before accounts become at\-risk.
* Lead customer escalations and executive engagement when needed, modeling consultative problem\-solving and strategic partnership.
* Use data\-driven insights to identify trends, predict churn drivers, and develop targeted interventions that improve customer outcomes at scale.
* Collaborate with Sales and Revenue Operations on contract negotiations, and expansion plays.


**Operational Excellence \& Process Development**


* Analyze team performance data and customer engagement patterns to identify inefficiencies and implement process enhancements.
* Build and refine CS playbooks, workflows, and engagement models that enable consistent, high\-quality customer experiences.
* Lead the identification and delivery of training programs, partnering cross\-functionally to close skill gaps and elevate team capabilities.
* Drive adoption of CS tools and platforms (e.g., ChurnZero, HubSpot, Chargebee) to improve efficiency, visibility, and impact measurement.
* Establish clear success metrics, reporting cadences, and performance dashboards that demonstrate CS impact on retention and revenue.
* Partner with CS Operations and enablement teams to ensure your team has the tools, resources, and support needed to excel.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership and Collaboration**


* Serve as a key voice of the customer, synthesizing feedback and insights to inform Product, Marketing, and Go\-to\-Market strategies.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs, influence roadmap priorities, and drive product improvements.
* Collaborate with Marketing on customer communications, launch readiness, and customer marketing initiatives.
* Work closely with Sales and Onboarding on handoff processes, account transitions, and alignment on customer segmentation and coverage models.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives to improve customer satisfaction, reduce time\-to\-value, and drive product\-led growth outcomes.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager (contract)
jobs.description:
We're looking for a hands\-on Social Media Manager \- a creator and strategist who makes things, not a calendar manager. Your job is to produce short\-form content basically every day and turn everything happening around The Realest into content people can't scroll past.


We have an incredible amount of natural content already. Between our founder, the merchandise, the auctions, the athletes and artists, our partners, our customers, and everything happening around the business, you won't have to manufacture much. The job is to recognize the story fast, frame it the right way, shoot and edit it, and get it out. You'll spot it, capture it, package it, and publish it \- quickly.


This is a role built on speed, autonomy, and experimentation. We'd much rather you test ten smart ideas than overthink one for a week. Individual posts that don't land are completely fine, that's the cost of moving fast and learning what works.  

  

**This starts as a contract role with the potential to convert to full\-time down the line.**

 **Create great content, every day**

* Produce short\-form video daily \- recognize the story quickly, frame it, shoot it, edit it, and ship it
* Turn the natural content around us into gold: merchandise, auctions, athletes and artists, partners, customers, and live moments
* Concept, capture, and edit from start to finish — Reels, TikToks, Shorts, Stories, graphics, and real\-time content that feels native to each platform
* Keep the voice unmistakably The Realest — real, in\-the\-know, and made for collectors

**Partner on founder\-led content**

* Work closely with our founder, who's naturally one of the faces of the business
* Spot opportunities for founder\-led content that feels authentic \- never forced, never generic "CEO content"

 **Tell customer and collector stories**

* Fluent in collectible culture, with a home base on X. Comfortable across all platforms, but especially dialed into X, where the collectors are and the conversation happens \- engaging and jumping into the discussions daily, not just posting.
* Catch the reactions when collectors receive their items, and the moments with athletes and partners

**Build formats, not just posts**

* When something works, turn it into a repeatable format, template, or franchise rather than treating every post as a one\-off
* Develop recurring series that give The Realest a recognizable rhythm and identity

**Experiment, measure, and lean in**

* Try a lot, watch what performs, understand why, and double down on what's working
* Stay extremely aware of internet culture, formats, and what's landing — but translate it through an elevated The Realest lens. We should feel current and fast without chasing every meme or trend
* Track views, saves, shares, and follower growth, and turn the numbers into your next move

**Run creator and influencer engagement (secondary)**

* Identify and work with creators, influencers, and brand ambassadors who fit our mission \- a meaningful part of the role, but always secondary to creating great content ourselves

 **Requirements** **Who You Are**

* A maker first — you see the post before you pick up the phone, and you'd rather ship than sit on an idea
* Fast and autonomous: you spot the story and run with it without waiting for a brief
* Fluent in internet culture and where attention is going, with the taste to filter it through an elevated brand lens
* Equal parts creative and analytical — you love a good hook and a good data point
* Someone who genuinely gets why memorabilia matters to the people who collect it

 **What We're Looking For**


Honestly, we care much more about taste, instincts, and great work than about checking traditional experience boxes. We're not counting years.

* **A strong portfolio of short\-form content you've personally shot and edited — this is what matters most**
* Hands\-on craft across filming and editing, with tools like Adobe Premiere, CapCut, or whatever gets you there (phone\-first is fine — we care about the eye, not the gear)
* Fluency across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, and Facebook \- the tools, the culture, and how each platform's algorithm actually works
* An instinct for formats and franchises \- you recognize a repeatable idea when you see one
* Comfort with analytics (native platform insights, Google Analytics, and similar) and the instinct to act on what they tell you
* **Based in or around Los Angeles and able to be on\-site, with flexibility to travel for key events**
* A genuine interest in sports, music, or movie memorabilia \- you should get why this stuff matters

This position will be responsible for strengthening the firm’s online presence, developing engaging digital content, and implementing marketing strategies designed to increase brand awareness and generate qualified leads.

Responsibilities

* Develop and execute digital marketing strategies across multiple platforms.
* Manage and grow the firm’s presence on social media, including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sales Coordinator — Commercial Roofing

**ROOFCORP of America \| Anaheim, CA (on\-site) \| Full\-time, 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM, Monday–Friday** **Pay: $28\.00–$34\.00 per hour (non\-exempt, overtime eligible) \+ benefits**

About us

ROOFCORP of America has been repairing, restoring, and replacing commercial flat roofs since 1985\. We work in TPO, built\-up roofing, and silicone restoration for building owners and property managers across California, Oregon, Washington, and Alaska. We are a family\-run company with a simple standard: do honest work, do it right, and take care of the customer. Quality here is personal, not a department.

Our Anaheim office runs our Pacific Southwest operations. This is a working office — steady volume, real deadlines, and a team that supports each other.

The role

The Sales Coordinator is the hub of our sales operation. Our estimators are out on roofs and our sales team is in front of customers — you are the person who makes sure nothing behind them falls through the cracks. Proposals go out on time, bids get submitted before the deadline, follow\-ups actually happen, and our customer records are accurate.

If you like order, deadlines, and being the person everyone relies on, you will do well here.

What you'll do

Take in incoming leads, service calls, and bid invitations, and log every one of them accurately the same day.

Build and format roof condition reports and proposals from estimator field notes and photos — clean, professional, and error\-free before they reach a customer.

Track the bid board: due dates, addenda, plan\-room submittals, and prequalification packets. Confirm every submission goes out complete and on time.

Schedule roof inspections and estimator appointments, and coordinate routing so field time is used well.

Follow up on outstanding proposals on a set schedule and keep the pipeline current so leadership always knows where every opportunity stands.

Maintain customer and project records: contacts, insurance certificates and contract documents.

Coordinate daily with our Anaheim field team, our Seattle sales leadership, and our back\-office team in Bogotá, Colombia.

Produce weekly pipeline and sales activity reports for the Sales Manager.

What you need

* 2\+ years in a sales coordination, estimating support, project administration, or inside\-sales support role. Construction, roofing, or another trade is a strong plus.
* Excellent written English. You will be preparing documents that go directly to building owners and property managers.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel and Word. Comfortable learning new software quickly.
* Genuine attention to detail. In this seat, a wrong address or a missed deadline costs real money.
* The ability to juggle competing priorities without losing track of any of them.
* Dependable on\-site attendance, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

**Preferred:** Bilingual English/Spanish. Experience with CRM systems or commercial property management customers.

What we offer

* $28\.00–$34\.00 per hour, depending on experience. Candidates with commercial roofing, bid platform, or property management experience start at the upper end.
* Medical / dental / vision
* Paid time off and holidays
* A stable, 40\-year\-old company with a family culture and room to grow. Several of our people have been with us for decades.

How to apply

Send your resume to martha@roofcorp.com

*ROOFCORP of America is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with applicable law.*

Pay: $28\.00 \- $34\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid training
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

The Company also offers a full range of benefits, including medical, dental, and 401k. Your recruiter can share more details about the specific compensation package during the hiring process.

**The Accurate Way:**


We offer a fun, fast\-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.

  



**Take ownership.**


Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.  



**Be open.**


Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.

 **Stay curious.**


Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.

 **Work as one.**


Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.

 **Equal opportunities**

Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.

  

This posting is open for U.S.\-based candidates who currently reside in the following states: CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MD, MN, NC, NY, OH, OK, PA, TN, TX, VA, WA, WV

  

For Court Runner opportunities, candidates may also reside in: AZ, DE, KY, MI, NH, NV

**Culture of Care****:**


At the South Orange County Community College District (SOCCCD), we foster a Culture of Care grounded in connection, collaboration, inclusion, and service. We seek employees who contribute to a welcoming, student\-centered environment and who understand the important role every position plays in advancing student success and strengthening our District community. Our employees build meaningful relationships, demonstrate empathy and professionalism, and promote a culture of belonging, engagement, and mutual respect.

Communicate and coordinate with Admissions, Counseling, Student Services, and other campus departments to assist with international student needs and referrals.
Assist with preparing reports, correspondence, spreadsheets, forms, and other office materials.
Provide general administrative support, including filing, scanning, copying, data entry, and maintaining office supplies and materials.
Maintain confidentiality and handle student and other sensitive information in accordance with applicable policies and procedures.
Perform other related duties as assigned. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Knowledge of:**
Basic office practices, procedures, and customer service principles.
General college admissions, enrollment, and student support services, particularly those affecting international students.
Basic concepts related to international student admissions and immigration documentation; training will be provided.
Basic recordkeeping and data\-entry practices.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative – Beauty & Wellness Partnerships
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

Business Development Representative – Beauty \& Wellness Partnerships

Location: Orange County, CA

Job Type: Full\-Time / Part\-Time

Compensation: Base Pay \+ Competitive Commission

About the Role

We are seeking an energetic, outgoing, and results\-driven Business Development Representative to help expand our local partnership network throughout Orange County.

The primary focus of this position is to develop relationships with local hair salons, nail salons, beauty salons, massage studios, spas, wellness businesses, and other beauty\-related businesses and create mutually beneficial referral and promotional partnerships.

This is a field\-based business development and sales position. The ideal candidate is comfortable visiting local businesses, introducing our services in person, building relationships with owners and managers, and turning those relationships into ongoing referral opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and visit potential beauty and wellness business partners throughout Orange County
* Build relationships with hair salons, nail salons, beauty salons, massage studios, spas, and other local businesses
* Introduce our medical aesthetics and wellness services to potential partners
* Develop referral and cross\-promotional partnerships
* Distribute approved marketing materials and explain current promotions
* Follow up consistently with business owners and managers
* Maintain and grow existing partnership accounts
* Generate qualified referrals and new client opportunities
* Track outreach activities, leads, partnerships, and referral results
* Represent our company professionally at local businesses, networking events, and community events
* Work closely with management to develop new local marketing and partnership opportunities

Qualifications

* Previous experience in sales, business development, outside sales, beauty, aesthetics, wellness, hospitality, or local marketing is preferred
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Comfortable approaching and speaking with business owners and managers
* Self\-motivated and goal\-oriented
* Strong relationship\-building and follow\-up skills
* Familiarity with Orange County communities and local businesses is a plus
* Existing relationships within the beauty, salon, spa, or wellness industry are highly preferred
* Must be comfortable with local travel throughout Orange County
* Bilingual English/Chinese, English/Spanish, or English/Korean is a plus

Compensation

We offer base pay plus a competitive commission structure, with strong earning potential based on performance.

The more qualified partnerships and business opportunities you develop, the greater your earning potential.

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Costa Mesa, CA 92627

This is a hybrid position, requiring both office and field work. Some days will be spent in the office coordinating projects, while others will involve visiting job sites, meeting clients, accompanying homeowners to design centers, and running project\-related errands.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator – Melanoma and Cutaneous Oncology Program
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Cutaneous Oncology clinical research team supports a diverse portfolio of studies for melanoma and non\-melanoma skin cancers, including squamous cell, basal cell, and Merkel cell carcinomas. The team partners with specialists across Dermatology, Medical Oncology, Surgical Oncology, and Radiation Oncology to provide comprehensive, multidisciplinary care. Our focus includes outpatient, therapeutic cancer clinical trials in phases I–III, including both industry\-sponsored and investigator\-initiated studies. We also manage noninterventional studies aimed at improving early detection, risk assessment, and long\-term survivorship.


The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will independently, or with general direction, execute, manage, and coordinate clinical research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Manager, Principal Investigator (PI), and/or the Associate Director of Clinical Research Programs for the Early Phase program. The CRC will coordinate the administrative, data, and patient scheduling operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols and regulatory policies.


Duties may include, but will not be limited to, supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies; managing and updating databases to ensure data integrity; acting as intermediary between sponsors, research staff, and various UCSF departments; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies;; maintaining relevant regulatory documents in partnership with the Regulatory department; reporting study progress to investigators; participating in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and performing other duties as assigned.  



**Department Overview:**

The UCSF Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (HDFCCC) is one of only two cancer centers in the Bay Area to receive the prestigious designation of “comprehensive” from the National Cancer Institute (NCI).


The HDFCCC integrates the work of researchers and clinicians dedicated to four fundamental pursuits: laboratory research into the causes of cancer progression; clinical research to translate new knowledge into viable treatments; compassionate, state\-of\-the\-art patient care; and population research that can lead to improvements in prevention, early detection, and quality\-of\-life for those living with cancer. The twin pillars of precision medicine and precision population health guide research and treatment at HDFCCC.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Nadsto is a stone supplier and fabrication company specializing in countertops, slabs, and custom stone projects for homeowners, designers, contractors, and builders. We help customers move from material selection through fabrication and installation by managing the details, coordinating the right people, and keeping projects organized from start to finish.

We are a growing, hands\-on business looking for someone who can bring structure, follow\-through, and strong communication to our sales and project workflow.

**Role Overview**

Nadsto is hiring a **Project Coordinator** to help manage incoming leads, customer follow\-up, project scheduling, contractor coordination, and internal tracking systems.

This role is ideal for someone who is organized, customer\-focused, and excited to grow with a fast\-scaling company. The position is designed to start with lead management, project coordination, scheduling, and communication, with the opportunity to grow into a **Project Manager** or another higher\-level operations role as the company expands.

The right person will be proactive, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast\-moving small business environment where systems are being improved and responsibilities may evolve over time. You do not need to be a construction expert, but you should be detail\-oriented, willing to learn, and able to take ownership of keeping leads and projects moving forward.

The Project Coordinator will play an important role in making sure customers are followed up with, project details are accurate, contractors are coordinated, and jobs continue moving smoothly through each stage of the process.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage new customer inquiries and enter lead information into the company tracking system.
* Follow up with prospective customers by phone, email, and/or text to help move leads forward.
* Schedule showroom appointments, consultations, templates, layout meetings, fabrication, demolition, and installation steps.
* Keep lead and project tracking sheets accurate and up to date.
* Track lead stages, project stages, next follow\-up dates, notes, and customer communication.
* Help customers understand the next steps in the process and provide timely updates.
* Coordinate with internal team members, suppliers, fabricators, installers, demolition contractors, and other project partners.
* Send project details to contractors, including customer information, address, scope, timing, and job requirements.
* Request and organize contractor updates, before/after photos, job notes, and completion confirmations.
* Help identify missing information, scheduling issues, or project details that need clarification.
* Support the transition from accepted estimate to active project.
* Monitor project milestones to help ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
* Assist with payment follow\-up, project documentation, and post\-installation follow\-up.
* Help maintain a professional and organized customer experience from first inquiry through project completion.

**Qualifications**

* 1–3\+ years of experience in a coordinator, administrative, customer service, showroom, sales support, scheduling, or operations role.
* Experience in construction, home services, interior design, flooring, tile, cabinetry, countertops, remodeling, or a showroom environment is a plus.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple leads, tasks, and projects at the same time.
* Comfortable communicating with customers by phone and email.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately track notes, dates, statuses, and next steps.
* Comfortable using Google Sheets, spreadsheets, calendars, email, and basic digital tools.
* Ability to follow systems, checklists, and standard operating procedures.
* Proactive follow\-up style; able to keep things moving without constant reminders.
* Professional, friendly, and customer\-focused communication style.
* Comfortable working with contractors, vendors, and internal team members.
* Able to work in a small business environment where priorities can shift quickly.
* Willingness to learn about stone materials, fabrication, installation, and the overall renovation process.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Salary range: **$60,000–$80,000 per year**, depending on experience.
* Opportunity for performance\-based bonuses.
* Growth opportunity into a larger operations, sales coordination, or project management role.
* Hands\-on training in stone materials, fabrication, installation, customer management, and project coordination.
* Opportunity to play a key role in improving systems, customer experience, and project workflow within a growing company.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Why Join Ivo?**
=================


Every civilization runs on the same infrastructure: agreements between people who don't fully trust each other. Sumerians pressed them into clay. Romans carved them into stone. We bury them in 80\-page PDFs.


The way those agreements are reviewed hasn't changed in four thousand years — a human reads the whole thing and tries not to miss anything. We're building the AI that finally changes that. Ivo is the contract intelligence platform of choice for companies like Uber, Meta, Canva, IBM, and Shopify. We recently raised our Series B and have grown 800% over the last 12 months.

**What You'll Do**
==================


We are seeking a highly organized and resourceful Recruiting Coordinator who can keep our hiring pipeline moving. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys checklists, fast turnarounds, and clear communication. You’ll work closely with hiring managers and leadership to ensure a seamless and high\-quality candidate experience while helping us build efficient hiring processes.

==================================

### **Interview Scheduling:**

* Coordinate Zoom/Google Meet \& in\-person calendars across time zones
* Manage scheduling logistics between candidates and interviewers
* Send confirmations, reminders, and feedback requests
* Ensure interviewers have scorecards and candidate info

* Review incoming résumés against role scorecards

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date candidate records in our ATS
* Ensure candidates are moved through stages correctly and consistently
* Remind interviewers to submit timely feedback
* Conduct daily reviews of candidates to ensure no one is “stuck” in process

### **Source \& attract talent**

* Use LinkedIn, job boards, and online communities to identify passive talent
* Add prospects to our ATS (Ashby) with clean notes and tags

### **Collaborate with hiring teams**

* Gather feedback quickly, flag bottlenecks, and suggest process tweaks to improve speed


and quality of hire.
* Proactively share updates on candidate progress, scheduling, and bottlenecks
* Flag risks or delays early to keep hiring processes moving

**What You'll Gain:**
=====================

* Hands\-on mentorship in sourcing and recruiting
* Clear growth path into Senior Sourcer or Full\-Cycle Recruiter
* Exposure to hiring across multiple functions in a high\-growth startup
* Real ownership over building candidate pipelines
* Competitive early\-career compensation

**Compensation \& Benefits**
============================

* **Competitive Compensation:** Final offer details are determined based on experience, expertise, and overall fit.
* **Equity:** Meaningful ownership in a company that's scaling fast
* **Health \& Wellness:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to suit the needs of you and your family.
* **Flexible Spending \& Insurance:** Access to HSA and FSA accounts, plus life insurance coverage.
* **401(k) Program:** Save for the future with our 401(k) program.
* **Commuter Benefits:** We help make getting to and from the office easier and more convenient.
* **Unlimited PTO:** So you can take the time you need to recharge, stay healthy, and bring your best self to work.
* **Office Perks:** Enjoy a vibrant Downtown San Francisco office with catered lunch five days a week, premium snacks and coffee, an in\-building gym, and a dog\-friendly environment.
* **401(k) Retirement Plan** Save for the future with our 401(k) program.

**FAQ**

* *What stage of growth is Ivo at?:* We launched in early access in 2023\. Since then, we’ve had an incredible response from the market and are growing rapidly. We 6x'd in ARR in the last 12 months. Our clients include companies like Uber, Reddit, IBM, Canva, Pinterest, DoorDash, and more. We're happy to share more details with candidates who go through our interview process.

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Regional Operations Coordinator – Commercial Foodservice

**Company:** Plaztigo

**Location:** San Francisco Bay Area / Northern California (Field Sales)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time W\-2 (Exempt Regional Operations Coordinator)

**Compensation:** 100% Top\-Line Commission (Uncapped) \+ IRS Standard Mileage Reimbursement

**Estimated Year 1 Earnings:** $75,000 – $150,000\+ (Based on deal volume \& portfolio growth)

**Benefits:** Health/Medical Insurance NOT Included

**About Plaztigo**

Plaztigo is a modern commercial supply and distribution platform offering **700\+ SKUs**—everything a restaurant, commercial kitchen, bakery, or venue needs under one roof. Beyond our broad product catalog, we feature **custom manufacturing capabilities** for custom\-printed packaging, chopstick sleeves, and tailored branding solutions for commercial operators.

Backed by local Hayward warehouse inventory, custom printing, and a native mobile app/e\-commerce site for frictionless re\-ordering, we give foodservice businesses every reason to partner with us for years.

**The Opportunity**

As a **Regional Operations Coordinator**, you will drive field growth across Northern California by opening new commercial accounts, introducing operators to our custom branding and distribution depth, and onboarding clients onto our digital ordering portal.

**100% Full Compensation \& Earnings Transparency**

This is an **Exempt W\-2 Regional Operations Coordinator position operating on 100% Top\-Line Commission**. There is **no base salary**, but you receive direct payouts on every collected invoice dollar, fully backed by standard legal expense reimbursements.

* **Upfront Digital Onboarding Bonus:** **3\.5% on total top\-line invoice revenue** for the first paid order when you close and onboard a client onto our web/app portal.
* **12\-Month Recurring Residuals:** **2\.5% monthly residual** on all recurring re\-orders placed during the account’s first 12 months.
* **Full Expense Reimbursement:** Paid at the standard **IRS Business Mileage Rate** for all field travel between client sites (covering fuel, wear\-and\-tear, and vehicle operation).
* **Sample \& Sales Backing:** 100% company\-funded physical product sample kits, custom\-print proofs, and digital collateral.
* **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance are not provided for this role.

**Uncapped Account Earnings: Real Examples**

There is **no ceiling on account size or payout**. Closing larger accounts directly multiplies your recurring monthly checks:

* **Typical Retailer ($4,000/mo volume):** Pays **$140 upfront** \+ **$100/mo** recurring residual ($1,200/yr).
* **5\-Location Local Chain ($25,000/mo volume):** Pays **$875 upfront** \+ **$625/mo** recurring residual ($7,500/yr).
* **Regional Group / Sub\-Distributor ($100,000/mo volume):** Pays **$3,500 upfront** \+ **$2,500/mo** recurring residual ($30,000/yr) from a **single account**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Field Prospecting:** Conduct face\-to\-face sales calls with restaurant owners, multi\-unit operators, commercial kitchens, and venue buyers across Northern California.
* **Digital Onboarding:** Guide clients through setup on our mobile app or web portal for automated re\-ordering.
* **Account Portfolio Management:** Monitor re\-order patterns ($3k–$5k\+/mo target volume per retail account) and follow up proactively to maintain monthly residual income.
* **Active Field Presence:** Spend more than 50% of working time active in the field meeting with buyers.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

* **2\+ Years B2B Sales Experience:** Proven track record in commercial packaging, foodservice distribution, beverage/food supply, or jan/san supplies.
* **Active Operator Network:** Pre\-existing, active relationships with Bay Area restaurant owners, hospitality groups, or commercial food buyers is required.
* **Self\-Driven Portfolio Builder:** Motivated by building a long\-term, high\-earning recurring commission portfolio.
* **Field Mobility:** Valid CA driver’s license, reliable personal vehicle, and active auto insurance.

Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

Become part of one of the largest and fastest\-growing privately held security companies in the U.S! Since 1998, Sunstates Security has built a national reputation for delivering exceptional services while fostering high\-quality work environments for our team. We are dedicated to hiring, developing, and retaining a professional workforce that reflects our commitment to excellence.


We believe in strategic reinvestment in our people by offering a benefits package that exceeds industry standards, pathways for career advancement, extensive internal training, and employee recognition programs. Our commitment to a superior workplace culture is reflected in our most recent national accolades. Additionally, we have been named a **2026 Training MVP**by Training Magazine, marking the third consecutive year we have accepted this prestigious recognition. We also continue to be celebrated for our steady growth and stability on the **Inc. 5000** list of America’s fastest\-growing private companies.

  

At the heart of everything we do are our core values of honor, integrity, and trust. If you are searching for a rewarding career with a proactive security partner that protects some of the country’s leading organizations, we invite you to explore the possibilities at Sunstates Security. Join a successful, growing team where your talent is appreciated and have opportunities to advance your professional career.

 ***HIRING IMMEDIATELY***

  

Sunstates Security is hiring an experienced **Security Account Manager** for a client site in **Santa Clara, CA. T**his position offers a an annualsalary of **$70,000/paid weekly.** The Account Manager is responsible for the daily functioning of client site locations including operations, customer service, personnel management, security \& safety in accordance with Sunstates and client objectives. Shall be available to support the services and any related issues arising from the service agreement.

 **ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Responsible for the direction, coordination, and management of all site Security Personnel.
* Identify and recruit new talent with the assistance of the HR department.
* Process new employees through the Sunstates Security onboarding system.
* Train, develop, motivate and empower Security Officers to oversee all day\-to\-day operations of the site and promote the highest standards of efficiency, profitability, customer service and ethics.
* Train subordinates on procedural guidelines, company policies, and operational \& site specific forms.

**Operations:**

**Cost Control \& Budgetary:**

* **Business Development \& Customer Relations:**

* Promote Sunstates reputation of professionalism and ethics; and to create and expose new and existing opportunities and markets.

* Experience with facilities management/floor operations
* Willing to undergo an extensive background check
* Must have prior security, law enforcement, or military experience

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Account Manager**
===================

  

**Date:** Aug 24, 2026


**Location:** San Jose, California, United States


**Company:** Super Micro Computer


**Job Req ID: 29999**
---------------------


**About Supermicro:**
---------------------


Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the \#5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.  

  



**Job Summary:**
----------------


Supermicro Computer is looking for an Account Manager who has experience with selling technical solutions and developing business. The ideal candidate must also have a proven track record in winning enterprise level relationships and consistently achieving and exceeding assigned sales quotas.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
------------------------------------------


* Manage products through their entire lifecycle until product EOL


* Develop strategic sales goals with exceptional execution to meet the sales target


* Qualify leads and creating target lists of enterprise or data center accounts


* Seek potential customers (e.g., Corporate Customers, Value\-Added Resellers, OEMs) through cold calling and follow\-up customer visits


* Participate in marketing activities such as trade shows to generate leads


* Ability to strategically positioned Supermicro’s products and services in the market


* Develop customer relationships and maintain/manage accounts, expand existing client accounts for retention and potential growth


* Work with cross functional teams to draft and negotiate various types of contracts


* Manage day\-to\-day sales operations


* Negotiate sales pricing, monitoring orders, facilitating credit issues and negotiating sales returns


**Qualifications:**
-------------------


* Bachelor degree in business, engineering or similar fields preferred

• 1 year of hands\-on experience with selling computer hardware solutions to data center or enterprise accounts (prior software or telecom sales will be considered) preferred
  

• Successful track record with credible cold calling and follow\-up with key decision makers
  

• Ability to thrive both independently and in a team environment
  

• Demonstrated ability in the following areas: pre\-call planning, opportunity qualification and objection handling, call structure and control, time and territory management
  

• Strong persuasive and negotiating skills; Ability to polished words in verbal, written, and presentation
  

• Extremely proactive, highly organized, with proven ability to manage multiple tasks
  

• Exceptional management skill in time and territory
**Salary Range**
----------------


$72,500 \- $104,000


The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs.


**EEO Statement**
-----------------


Supermicro is an Equal Opportunity Employer and embraces diversity in our employee population. It is the policy of Supermicro to provide equal opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or special disabled veteran, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Set goals, strategy and execution action plan to achieve quota consistently year over year
* Sell Litili’s Value Proposition to build, maintain and progress a strong pipeline and to obtain revenue goals
* Responsible for account collection to keep customers AR current
* Developing on going customer relationships
* Establish organizational maps of client business units
* Identify key stakeholders
* Discover opportunities, issues and risks
* Educate customers about Litili’s solutions and capabilities
* Visit customers in person on regular call schedule
* Problem solve and be resourceful to the customers to provide exceptional experience
* Identifying and calling on potential new customers
* Research and develop prospects into customers
* Be creative and show tenacity with developing new business leveraging all key engagement tactics (LinkedIn, phone, email, text)
* Delivering value propositions that meet the customer’s need
* Ask open ended questions, listen and understand customer needs
* Combine learnings from customers with Litili’s value proposition to drive existing customers loyalty and sales and to acquire new ones
* Attend sales meetings and training as required

* Update prospecting activity (pipeline, calls, KPIs,….) in CRM weekly
* Update customer activity (pipeline, calls, KPIs,….) in CRM weekly
* Update account contact information on a regular basis
* Provide monthly forecasting
* Representing Litili internally and externally
* Maintain presence at industry events to maximize sales opportunities and promote company representation and relevance
