jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager, AMER
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE:**



We are looking for a strategic and consultative Strategic Account Manager to join our Global Account Management team in AMER. This role is focused on nurturing and expanding Talon.One's most valuable enterprise client relationships—including global brands like Adidas, H\&M, and Sephora. You'll serve as a trusted advisor, responsible for driving growth, retention, and satisfaction across a portfolio of high\-value accounts.

  


**ABOUT THE TEAM**



The Global Account Management team is a key driver of Talon.One's international growth, focused exclusively on the retention and commercial expansion of our most strategic global enterprise customers. Led by our Director of Strategic Account Management, the Americas team currently consists of three experienced Strategic Account Directors, each responsible for managing and growing a defined portfolio of top\-tier clients.



We act as internal champions for our clients — building deep, influential relationships with senior stakeholders and collaborating cross\-functionally with Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Engineering to deliver a seamless customer experience. Our mission is to ensure every strategic account maximizes the value of Talon.One's platform—delivering measurable business results and building long\-lasting partnerships.



This is a remote role; however, you must be located within commuting distance of one of our US hubs: New York, Boston, Chicago, Denver, or San Francisco. This role also requires travel, estimated at 25–40% of the time to meet key clients in\-region.

  


**ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL:**


* Own a portfolio of select high\-value strategic accounts, developing long\-term relationships and account plans to ensure product adoption, retention, and growth.
* Identify and drive expansion opportunities within your accounts (e.g. new use cases, product modules, geographies, or business units).
* Partner closely with Customer Success Managers, Technical Account Managers, and Solution Engineers to ensure ongoing customer success and high product engagement.

**About Karius**



Karius is a life science, venture\-backed clinical metagenomics company, focused on elevating patient care through microbial insights. We are committed to advancing diagnostic science and technology to optimize the diagnosis and treatment of infectious diseases. Through the use of genomics and AI, we are driven to improve the diagnostic landscape for infectious diseases. Karius delivers unprecedented diagnostic insight detecting microbial cell\-free DNA circulating in the body to assist physicians to make rapid treatment decisions.

We are seeking a talented Digital Marketing Manager to help accelerate awareness and adoption of Karius’s metagenomic testing portfolio across the hospital and outpatient settings. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, executing and optimizing comprehensive digital channel growth strategies in partnership with internal teams and agency partners. This role requires experience managing digital marketing channels in the healthcare setting, strong communication and organizational skills, a curious mindset, and a passion for helping patients and clinicians.

Karius aims to conquer infectious diseases through innovations around genomic sequencing and machine learning. The company’s platform is already delivering unprecedented insights into the microbial landscape, providing clinicians with a comprehensive test capable of identifying more than a thousand pathogens directly from blood, and helping industry accelerate the development of therapeutic solutions. The products Karius offers today are some of the most advanced solutions available to physicians who aim to deliver better care to many otherwise ineffectively treated patients. Our tests are the result of some incredible work done by our scientists, statisticians, engineers, and physicians, all driven by the same mission. You, as part of the Karius team, will be able to see how directly your work has a life\-changing impact on people, and at scale.

jobs.description:
**MISSION STATEMENT:**

Founded in 1994, **Teen Esteem (TE)** educates, equips and empowers **K\-12 students**, parents and educators throughout Alameda and Contra Costa Counties. Our team of speakers meets directly with students in schools and emphasizes the importance of self\-respect and respect for others. TE's dynamic, interactive classroom presentations and school assemblies address current challenges students face in school and at home**.** We are committed to promoting healthy choices and risk avoidance using accurate, up\-to\-date statistics and information to support our presentations.

**Our message to kids and teens is that their value is based on WHO they are**, *not* the choices they make. We emphasize that it is never too late to get their life back on track!

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

We are **\#hiring**! Part\-time. Impactful. Rewarding. Opportunity to join our incredible team equipping and empowering kids and teens throughout the East Bay. We're looking for exceptional talent seeking a flexible position.

Heart for kids and teens. Driven by community impact. Ready to take action.

This part\-time position will be part of a small, dynamic team. Lead Speaker is one of the stars of Teen Esteem’s speaker team. Reporting directly to the Executive Director, this gifted public speaker delivers our critical programming to students in schools throughout the Tri\-Valley. The position will assist in recruiting and training new speakers. In addition to implementing our classroom presentations and school assemblies, the Lead Speaker will assist in the development of new Social \& Emotional Learning (SEL) curriculum. As our Social Media Manager, this position will drive our content and messaging across multiple social media platforms.

The Lead Speaker \& Social Media Manager will be a positive, energetic team member ready to inspire our speakers and be passionate about the wellbeing of today’s kids and teens.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** \- Include but are not limited to the following:

**I. Lead Teen Esteem Program Speaker**

a. Engage high school, middle school and elementary school students in important conversations about the growing pains associated with growing up.

b. Listen, validate and encourage the voices of kids and teens.

c. Equip and empower students to navigate high\-risk choices they will encounter on the road to adulthood.

**II. Recruit and Train New Speakers**

a. Consistently seek new speakers to be champions for Teen Esteem’s mission.

b. Assist Director of Speakers with TE’s internship program via outreach to local community colleges and universities and participation in job/internship fairs.

c. Train speakers in accordance with the mission of Teen Esteem ensuring continuity and consistency in curriculum delivery.

d. Nurture and foster camaraderie amongst speaker team.

**III. Research \& Develop New Curriculum**

a. Research and stay current on relevant issues facing our youth.

b. Work alongside Executive Director to update existing curriculum and develop new presentations and assemblies that address the needs and wellbeing of kids and teens (typically a summer project).

**IV. Social Media \& Program Promotion**

a. Gather photos, videos and research for social media channels and promotion of Teen Esteem programs.

b. Develop content, post and disseminate relevant information across multiple social media platforms 3\-4 times each week at the direction of the Executive Director’s messaging priorities.

c. Monitor and provide reports on social media analytics quarterly.

d. Assist in creation of PowerPoint slide decks, Canva flyers and marketing projects.

**V. Team Player**

a. Understanding that working at a nonprofit requires supporting one another as a team; including participation in and support of fundraising efforts and events.

**EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE** – minimum requirements

o Bachelor’s degree.

o Public speaking and education experience.

o Experience creating and implementing programs and/or curriculum.

o Working knowledge or ability to learn software platforms such as Microsoft Office, Egnyte, Trello, Outlook, Slack, Google, Canva and Zoom.

o Non\-profit experience preferred.

**SKILLS \& ABILITIES**

o Passion for Teen Esteem’s mission, vision and local community.

o Possess high relational/emotional intelligence and gifted in social settings.

o Ability to work as a team member building trust and credibility.

o Excellent written communication skills.

o Comfortable in a fast\-paced environment and flexibility to adapt to change.

**WORKING CONDITIONS:** 

o In person work environment.

o Part\-time employee status approximately 20\+ hours/week during school year and 15\+ hours/week during summer break.

o Evenings and weekends will be required on occasion.

o Ability to obtain and maintain a California non\-commercial Class driver’s license.

o Must reside in the East Bay Area.

**SALARY:**

o $22\-24/hour based on experience.

o PTO and paid holidays.

Pay: $22\.00 \- $24\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
All Property Tech is a growing construction and property restoration company serving residential and commercial property owners throughout the Bay Area. We specialize in helping property owners, property managers, contractors, and insurance\-related partners navigate property damage and construction projects from the initial assessment through completion.

Our services include **water damage restoration, mold remediation, fire and smoke restoration, reconstruction, remodeling, property repairs, ADU construction, tenant improvements and other property improvement services.**

We are looking for a motivated, personable, and results\-driven **Business Development Representative** to help expand our network of referral partners and generate new business throughout the Bay Area.

Job Overview

The Business Development Representative will be responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with the people and businesses that can refer projects to All Property Tech.

This is a **relationship\-driven, field\-based sales position**. You will spend significant time meeting with potential referral partners, visiting businesses and job sites, attending networking events, following up with existing contacts, and identifying opportunities where All Property Tech can provide value.

The ideal candidate is someone who is comfortable walking into a business, introducing themselves, building relationships, and becoming the person people think of when they need a reliable construction or restoration company.

You do not need to be a construction expert on day one. We will provide training on our services and processes. What matters most is your ability to **build relationships, communicate professionally, follow up consistently, and generate business.**

What You'll Do

* Develop and maintain relationships with property managers, real estate professionals, insurance professionals, contractors, commercial property owners, HOAs, apartment communities, and other potential referral partners.
* Identify and develop new business opportunities throughout the Bay Area.
* Make in\-person visits to potential referral partners and establish All Property Tech as a trusted resource.
* Build and maintain a strong referral network.
* Follow up with existing contacts to generate repeat and referral business.
* Schedule meetings, property visits, inspections, and qualified opportunities for the appropriate All Property Tech team members.
* Educate potential partners about All Property Tech's restoration, construction, remodeling, and property repair services.
* Represent All Property Tech at networking events, trade shows, community events, and industry functions.
* Develop relationships with insurance agents, adjusters, property managers, real estate agents, contractors, and other professionals who regularly encounter property damage or construction needs.
* Identify opportunities involving water damage, mold, fire damage, reconstruction, remodeling, ADUs, and general property repairs.
* Maintain accurate records of contacts, meetings, referrals, opportunities, and follow\-ups.
* Track business development activities and report results to management.
* Work closely with estimators, project managers, and management to ensure qualified opportunities are properly communicated and handed off.
* Monitor market conditions, competitors, and opportunities for growth.
* Help develop creative strategies for increasing All Property Tech's visibility and referral network.
* Maintain a professional and positive representation of the All Property Tech brand.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is **personable, confident, organized, persistent, and comfortable building relationships.**

The right person doesn't need to be a pushy salesperson. Instead, they should be someone who enjoys meeting people, understands the importance of follow\-up, and can turn professional relationships into long\-term business opportunities.

Required Qualifications

* 1\+ year of experience in business development, sales, account management, customer service, construction, restoration, real estate, property management, or a related field preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Comfortable meeting new people and developing professional relationships.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently.
* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Professional appearance and communication style.
* Comfortable making phone calls, sending emails, and conducting in\-person business visits.
* Valid California driver's license and reliable transportation.
* Ability to travel throughout the Bay Area as needed.
* Comfortable using email, Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, and customer tracking systems.

Preferred Qualifications

* Existing relationships within the construction, restoration, insurance, real estate, or property management industries.
* Previous business development or outside sales experience.
* Experience working with property managers, apartment communities, HOAs, real estate professionals, contractors, or insurance professionals.
* Knowledge of residential or commercial construction.
* Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.
* Experience in the restoration or construction industry is a plus.

Who You'll Build Relationships With

A major part of this position will be developing referral relationships with:

* Property Management Companies
* Property Managers
* Real Estate Agents \& Brokers
* Insurance Agents
* Insurance Adjusters
* General Contractors
* Plumbers
* HVAC Companies
* Roofing Contractors
* Apartment Communities
* HOAs
* Commercial Property Owners
* Real Estate Investors
* Facility Managers
* Other Local Businesses \& Professionals

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position is measured by the strength of your relationships and the business you generate.

Key performance indicators may include:

* New referral partners established
* Qualified leads generated
* Referral opportunities

jobs.title: Foster Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Foster Program Coordinator**

**Schedule:**
The working schedule for this position is Tuesday \- Saturday, 9:30AM \- 6PM with Sunday and Monday day off. **Who We Are**
ACC is one of the nation’s largest open\-admission animal shelters, whose mission is to End Animal Homelessness in NYC. We touch the lives of nearly 20,000 animals each year. ACC is more than an animal shelter; we are a resource to the community, always seeking ways to keep the human\-animal bond intact. With a 90% placement rate, our progressive, life\-saving initiatives contribute to the successful placement of our animals.  

We strive to find loving homes for homeless and abandoned cats, dogs, guinea pigs and rabbits, both by adopting animals directly to the public and by partnering with more than 200 dedicated animal placement organizations (our New Hope partners). We also help keep NYC communities safe and rescue animals in need, responding to emergencies that involve animals as well as keeping our doors open 24/7 for people and animals in need. **Summary**  

The Foster Program Coordinator is responsible for maintaining the day\-to\-day operations of the foster program. As a Foster Program Coordinator, you will be responsible for coordinating the movement of animals in and out of foster homes, providing support to a network of over 800 foster parents, and help facilitate the adoption process for every animal in foster care.

**Required Qualifications**:* High School Diploma or GED required.
* The ideal candidate should have a minimum of two\-years work experience in a client facing position.
* Strong computer literacy required.
* Able to excel in a fast\-paced, often high\-stress, ever\-changing environment.
* Treat animals and people with respect and employ humane handling techniques whenever possible.
* Must be able to lift and move up to 50 lbs.

 **Benefits**
ACC values work/life balance and offers a generous paid\-time\-off (PTO) package that includes vacation time, birthdays off, personal days and sick pay. We also value physical and mental health by offering a great open access Cigna medical, dental and vision insurance at a low premium to our employees as well as 401K and Pension, Life Insurance. We also have on\-the\-job training for 2\-4 weeks, periodic all staff trainings to include safety, DEI, cross training, and other growth opportunities.


Because ACC is a nonprofit, employees may be eligible for loan forgiveness, cancellation, and/or consolidation under the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program (PSLF). Created under the College Cost Reduction and Access Act of 2007, PSLF allows borrowers who work full time for nonprofits and government agencies to have their outstanding debt forgiven tax\-free on Federal Direct Loans, after making 120 qualifying monthly payments under a qualifying repayment plan.


Please use this link for more details on our benefits package. **Essential Job Functions**:* Provide support to foster volunteers to ensure all their needs are being met. This includes answering questions, providing support for behavioral issues, following up with medical concerns, and handling other issues that may arise.
* Coordinate transportation of foster animals to foster volunteers, between care centers, and to adoption events.
* Coordinate with Veterinary Services to ensure foster animals leave the care center with appropriate vaccines and treatment plans, schedule follow\-up vet appointments, and assist with handling animals when appropriate.

 **Other Responsibilities**:* Assist in identifying appropriate foster animals for off\-site adoption, outreach, and media opportunities.
* Coordinate logistics for foster animals attending events including scheduling behavior assessments, medical, and transport.
* Assist Foster Supervisor with management of foster volunteer database.
* Secure appropriate photographs of animals for foster and events.
* Recruit new foster volunteers through orientations, interviews, and training.
* Lead Open Foster Hours, identify appropriate foster animals to new fosters.
* Fear Free certification within 30 days of hire.
* Complete other duties as assigned by supervisor.

 **Preferred Qualifications**:* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Prior experience with Microsoft Office Suite preferred.
* Prior experience with animals (dogs/cats/rabbits), either paid or volunteer, is strongly preferred but not required.
* Bi\-lingual (Spanish) preferred but not required.
* Customer\-driven and focused on providing a positive, upbeat, experience for all clients.
* High attention to detail, strong work ethic, and the ability to thrive while working in busy environment.
* Work well independently but also function seamlessly as a member of a team.

 **Work Environment:**
At ACC it's all hands\-on deck. We work together as a team, which means you may be asked to help with tasks that involve working outside in all sorts of weather. As a busy animal shelter in one of the biggest cities in the world it can get noisy inside. Employees should have the ability to remain calm yet professional in stressful situations involving animals and/or members of the public. ACC houses hundreds of animals in its facilities at any given time and with that comes fur, odors and other airborne particles in abundance.  

ACC offers many low\-cost services to pets and people in need. This includes compassionate end\-of\-life services for people who cannot afford to go to a private veterinary office but still want to provide a professional and peaceful transition for their beloved pet.  

Training will take place at our Manhattan Centers. Employees will report there until the Bronx location is fully operational. **Reports To:** Foster Supervisor **Overtime:** This is a non\-union position and is eligible for overtime.

jobs.description:
Drs. Shabnam Javdani and Erin Godfrey are seeking a Program Coordinator who is excited to implement a strong intervention, and to help shape and strengthen a growing program committed to changing the systems and conditions that constrain young people's lives. The candidate will coordinate and support the Resilience, Opportunity, Strength, Education, Safety (ROSES) Advocacy Program. Currently implemented in collaboration with the New York Community Trust, ROSES is a community\-based program pairing grisl and LGB/TGNC\+ youth experiencing school pushout or who have had police, probation, or court contact with a highly trained advocate. ROSES advocates work with young people in their communities free of charge to support them in their week, for 10\-15 weeks, working with clients by providing access to resources and education, helping girls and young people define individual goals, supporting the development of self\-efficacy skills, encouraging girls' and LGB/TGNC\+ youths' engagement with multiple social contexts (school, family, peer, etc.), and promoting contextual competence to reduce school pushout, and child welfare and legal system involvement.

The Program Coordinator also manages relationships with community partners and legal system stakeholders, collaborating across settings and systems within and outside of NYU, and supports youth and families through these complex systems. Lastly, the Program Coordinator will be expected to monitor and track program implementation and fidelity, including overseeing and carrying out day\-to\-day administrative tasks within NYU's infrastructure.

The role is well\-suited for someone who is passionate about advancing equity and who is equally comfortable discussing structural racism and inequity as they are overseeing project tasks, providing constructive and strengths\-based feedback to others, and trouble\-shooting implementation challenges. They will be comfortable providing weekly supervision and written feedback to advocates, providing on\-call individualized support to advocates, clients, and families, and collaborating closely with ROSES leadership and supervisors and community partners, to ensure high\-quality implementation of the intervention program. jobs.title: Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Production Coordinator


**Department:** Operations


**Reports to:** Director of Production Operations


**Classification:** Full\-Time, Exempt


**Annual Salary:** $65,000 – $75,000 (commensurate with experience)


**Work Location:** Hybrid / Flexible (Flexibility for project travel and work during evenings/weekends as required by show schedules.) *\*Note: Candidates based within \~60 miles of a CAMP NYC location are preferred.*


**ABOUT THE COMPANY**



CAMP is a Family Experience Company launched in 2018, known for our one\-of\-a\-kind shop/play hybrid experience at physical locations across the country. Each CAMP store features rotating themed experiences where families come to play, explore, and create unforgettable memories together. We believe that play connects us all, and at CAMP, play is bigger, bubblier, funnier, fuzzier, slimier, and sillier than anywhere else.


**WHAT IS THE ROLE?**



We are looking for a full\-time Production Coordinator to support day\-to\-day project execution across CAMP's Production department. In this hybrid role, you will work remotely day\-to\-day while maintaining full responsibility for on\-site execution during critical project phases. You are the meticulous organizer who keeps project schedules, file systems, and vendor inventories up to date, ensuring no detail falls through the cracks—whether virtually or on the ground at load\-ins, walk\-throughs, and live activations.


**WHAT YOU WILL DO/BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**


**Support Projects \& Vendor Logistics**


* **Project Tracking:** Maintain up\-to\-date project timelines, schedules, and task management tools across active initiatives.
* **File \& Information Management:** Organize production files, assets, and project data as updates arrive.
* **Vendor Operations:** Field initial vendor outreach, conduct vetting, and coordinate ongoing communications with external partners.
* **Sourcing \& Inventory:** Source props, materials, and small\-scale vendors; source post\-launch prop replacements and maintain accurate store ordering lists.
* **Budget Support:** Track project expenditures real\-time to maintain budget accuracy, assisting with financial reconciliations upon project wrap.
* **Client \& Team Syncs:** Draft updates and support client\-facing and internal progress meetings.


**Be the Boots\-on\-the\-Ground Lead**


* **On\-Site Execution:** Serve as the primary on\-site production contact for load\-in/out, walkthroughs, launches, and live events (requires occasional evening and weekend shifts).
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Align production schedules across store teams, cross\-functional partners, and outside vendors to eliminate schedule gaps.
* **Site Quality Assurance:** Perform regular check\-ins with store and show teams to maintain setup quality and address operational needs.
* **Training \& Compliance Documentation:** Create and track execution resources, including weekly store checklists, bi\-weekly carpenter logs, and compliance guides.
* **Brand \& IP Integrity:** Ensure all physical deliverables align with CAMP brand standards and partner/licensor IP guidelines in coordination with the Director of Production.
* **Set Maintenance:** Assist with set servicing and live show maintenance planning.


**Key Performance Indicators**


* **Schedule Completeness:** Comprehensive coverage of store and show operations with zero missed details.
* **Data Currency:** Real\-time accuracy of timelines, file structures, and purchasing lists without post\-project fixes.
* **Field Satisfaction:** High responsiveness and positive feedback from store staff and on\-site teams.
* **Brand \& Compliance Accuracy:** Flawless alignment with brand/IP guidelines during site load\-in and launch.
* **Budget Precision:** Ongoing budget tracking with clean, prompt post\-project wraps.


**WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO CAMP**


**Basic Qualifications**


* 3\+ years of project or production experience within experiential marketing, events, live entertainment, or brand activations.
* Strong organizational, administrative, and multi\-tasking skills across simultaneous workflows.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while managing tight deadline pressures.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills across technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* High attention to detail across both large\-scale logistics and minor administrative tasks.
* Flexibility for project travel and work during evenings/weekends as required by show schedules.


**Experience navigating brand/IP approval workflows is a plus**


**Physical Demands \& Travel**


* Ability to travel to and work on\-site at stores or activation locations, including nights and weekends.
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and move throughout store/event environments for extended periods.
* Capability to lift and carry props, materials, or equipment weighing up to 45 lbs.


**BENEFITS \& PERKS**


* Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage (including virtual visits)
* Health Care \& Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Life, AD\&D, and Long\-Term Disability Insurance
* 401(k) Plan (Employee Contribution)
* Flexible Paid Time Off to use for vacation, personal days, well\-being, or an illness
* Gym Reimbursement \& Commuter/Transit Benefits
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* 20% Employee Discount on merchandise across all CAMP retail stores

jobs.company: NYC Department of Housing Preservation & Development
jobs.title: Customer Service & Administrative Coordinator (Temp Position)
jobs.description:
**About the Agency**

The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3\.7 million homes in New York City. As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.

**Your Team**

The Office of the Commissioner provides strategic leadership and cross\-agency coordination for HPD, advancing the agency’s mission to promote quality, affordable housing and strong, diverse neighborhoods. The team works closely with divisions across HPD, City Hall, and external partners to support decision\-making, drive priority initiatives, and ensure effective execution of agency goals.

**Your Role**

As the **Customer Service \& Administrative Coordinator (Temp)**, you will support the Commissioner’s Office by helping ensure public inquiries are routed, tracked, and addressed in a timely manner. You will serve as a key point of contact for customers reaching the office, coordinate follow\-up with operational teams, and provide day\-to\-day administrative support to help the office run efficiently. Your role will also include supporting executive scheduling and meetings, managing shared office resources, and assisting with correspondence and other administrative needs.

**Your Responsibilities**

· Determine the appropriate workflow and operational unit responsible for issues raised through webform messages, assign inquiries to the appropriate queue, and establish due dates based on the type of request and the operational unit handling the matter.

· Follow up with Operational Groups on overdue cases and reroute cases as needed. Send customers written acknowledgment within 14 calendar days of receiving their inquiry, as required under the Mayor’s Directive.

· Answer calls from members of the public contacting the Commissioner’s Office and direct their inquiries or requests to the appropriate team.

· Provide ad hoc support to the Executive Assistant, including coordinating meetings, scheduling appointments, and maintaining the calendar to help avoid conflicts, keep appointments running on time, and ensure necessary materials are prepared.

· Facilitate conference room bookings for the Executive Senior Leadership team.

· Maintain office supply inventory, place orders as needed, and distribute supplies to staff upon request.

· Sort incoming mail and facilitate follow\-up or action as needed.

**Preferred skills** 

· Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally and effectively with members of the public and internal stakeholders.

· Excellent organizational and time\-management skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

· Demonstrated customer service skills and sound judgment when assessing inquiries and directing requests to the appropriate team.

· Ability to follow established procedures, track open items, and proactively follow up to support timely resolution.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook, Word, and Excel. Experience with scheduling, shared mailboxes, or case\-tracking systems is a plus.

· Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced executive office environment while handling sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your resume and cover letter to **OperationsHR@hpd.nyc.gov** with the subject line Customer Service \& Administrative Coordinator.

**Schedule:** This is a temporary, full\-time position of approximately 35 hours per week, with a typical schedule of 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday.

**Pay:** $28\.00 per hour

**Work Location:** In Person, 100 Gold Street New York, NY 10038

Job Types: Full\-time, Temporary

Pay: $28\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Community Coordinator \- W. H. Maxwell Career and Technical Education High School (19K660\)**
===============================================================================================


* Posted Date: Aug 25, 2026 Deadline: Sep 7, 2026
**Job Details**
---------------


### **Position Summary:**


Under the supervision of the Principal, the Community Coordinator will perform duties related to developing and improving community relations. The Community Coordinator will support the school in its efforts to increase and maintain communication between the school and our students, families, staff, and community partners and other community organizations and high schools and colleges. The Community Coordinator will similarly work to develop and sustain positive relations with other schools in the community and other organizations within the NYC Department of Education. The Community Coordinator will also work with local businesses, corporations and community\-based organizations to solicit interest in supporting and/or providing sites for the school’s fieldwork, internship, community service or community farming programs. Current groups working with the school include: Grant Associates, I Will Graduate, Project Pivot, Metalogic, etc. Performs related work.


### **Reports to:**


Principal


### **Key Relationships:**


Serves as a liaison between school administration and community groups by coordinating and facilitating communication between the school, staff, students, families, community organizations, businesses, government agencies and the communities that these vital organizations represent.


### **Responsibilities**


* Maintains ongoing contact with community based organizations (CBO’s) that are involved with providing services to support the school’s educational programs.
* Assists students and staff in building relationships with external partners including those connected to the school.
* Meets with community leaders and the administration to plan community events.
* Meets regularly and communicate with community partners to schedule a calendar of events for the fiscal year.
* Coordinates and supervises various outreach programs between the school and the neighboring community.
* Responsible for the supervision, planning, implementation, coordination, and monitoring of community development programs.
* Develops, coordinates and monitors partnerships and community development programs associated with the PTA and CBO’s.
* Prepares evaluation reports; performs analyses; and reviews program plans, funding and performance with various CBO’s.
* Works with our various departments and Parent Association to support and develop the community workshops.
* Prepares correspondence, documents, and other forms of written communication for internal and external community outreach purposes.
* Provides logistical and administrative support to the Parent Coordinator and the Principal related to community outreach and parent engagement.
* Encourages participation from the school’s community groups in recreational activities and assists with the provision of related operational support including outreach to community agencies.

### **Qualification Requirements:**


#### **Minimum**


* A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or


* High school graduation or equivalent and six years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties as described above; or


* Education and/or experience which is equivalent to **"1"** or **"2"** above. However, all candidates must have at least one year of experience as described in **"1"** above.


#### **Preferred**


* Public speaking ability and good people skills.
* Ability to interact with people of all social and economic levels.
* Prior experience in school setting and interaction with students, parents, and school staff.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to work with students, teachers, and supervisors.
* Knowledge of school program objectives.
* Strong literacy skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex issues when necessary.

### **Work Schedule:**


This is a 12 month, 35 hour per week annual assignment. Position will require flexibility with respect to work hours in order to meet the needs of the school community, including early mornings, evenings and weekends. Use of earned vacation and/or compensatory time is subject to approval of school principal.

$62,707 (New Hire Rate)

jobs.title: Community Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**

Flatbush Cats is a Brooklyn\-based 501(c)(3\) nonprofit working to reduce overcrowded animal shelters in New York City and prevent more cats from ending up on the street in the first place. What began as a grassroots rescue effort has grown into a citywide organization addressing the root causes through affordable veterinary care, access to spay/neuter services, and community outreach.

As an independent nonprofit—not backed by venture capital, private equity, or a corporate veterinary network—we make decisions based on our mission. We recruit team members who are passionate about expanding access to veterinary care and measure success by how many pets and families we can help, not production targets.

At the heart of our work is **Flatbush Veterinary Clinic**, a high\-volume nonprofit clinic serving low\-income pet owners, rescue organizations, and Trap\-Neuter\-Return (TNR) volunteers throughout Brooklyn. Each year, the clinic performs more than 7,500 spay/neuter surgeries—a number that continues to grow—while providing affordable wellness and dental care to thousands of pets.

By combining high\-quality veterinary care with a commitment to accessibility, we're helping keep pets with their families while creating a city where more people and pets can receive the support they need.

**What you’ll do:**

The Community Outreach Coordinator connects Flatbush Veterinary Clinic with residents, community\-based organizations, and neighborhood leaders. This individual\-contributor role coordinates the pet food pantry, supports trusted referral networks and partnership agreements, and operates offsite outreach events. The primary goal is to expand awareness of affordable veterinary services, remove barriers to care, help pet owners schedule and complete clinic appointments, and ensure outreach activities are consistently documented and measured.

\*\*\*\* Please note: To be considered, applications must be submitted through the link provided. Applications sent via Indeed will not be reviewed.

To apply, visit: https://www.flatbushcats.org/community\-outreach\-coordinator

**Work Schedule:** 

This is a full\-time position with a Monday through Friday workweek. Occasional evening or weekend hours may be required for offsite events, with advance scheduling whenever possible.

**What you’ll get:**

**Compensation**

The hourly pay range for this role is **$36\-$40** per hour, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

**Benefits**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance with 100% employer\-paid premiums
* Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) fully funded to cover the plan deductible, with funding levels based on coverage tier (employee\-only, employee \+ spouse, or family)
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with optional employee enrollment
* $500 annual employer contribution to the FSA, provided regardless of enrollment, plus an additional employer match of up to $500 for employees who enroll
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer match: 100% match on the first 3% of contributions, plus 50% match on contributions up to 5%
* Transit and parking benefit: $60 monthly employer contribution, applicable to either transit or parking at the employee’s discretion
* Paid time off, paid sick time, and paid holidays

**Responsibilities:**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Coordinate the Pet Food Pantry:** Support day\-to\-day pantry operations, including ordering, receiving, inventory and storage, eligibility and distribution processes, client communication, and accurate recordkeeping.
* **Build community relationships:** Develop trusted, culturally responsive relationships with Flatbush residents, community organizations, housing providers, schools, faith communities, businesses, and neighborhood leaders.
* **Connect pet owners with care:** Engage community members through outreach, explain available veterinary services and resources, identify barriers to care, and support appointment scheduling, follow\-through, and successful clinic visits.
* **Support community partnerships and referrals:** Maintain relationships with assigned partners, coordinate communication and referral pathways, track commitments and follow\-up, and connect community members with appropriate resources and services.
* **Coordinate mobile clinics and community outreach:** Support and execute mobile veterinary and vaccine clinics, spay/neuter booking events, food distributions, workshops, community fairs, NYCHA and tenant outreach, tabling, and other neighborhood\-based initiatives.
* **Manage event and outreach logistics:** Coordinate sites, supplies, transportation, volunteers, setup and breakdown, accessibility, appointment workflows, and post\-event follow\-up.
* **Support outreach communications:** Collaborate with clinic and communications teams to develop clear, accessible, and multilingual outreach materials, event messaging, and referral information.

**Rolling Stone: Account Manager**



Rolling Stone is seeking an Account Manager to join our New York\-based revenue team, reporting to the Vice President, Revenue Strategy \& Operations. This new role will serve as a critical link between Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Ad Operations, Program Execution, and our advertising partners.



The ideal candidate is a proactive, detail\-oriented, and client\-focused media professional who can manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. **Rolling Stone values in\-person collaboration and team cohesion, employees work onsite 4 days a week and 1 day remotely with a focus on maintaining a vibrant and inclusive culture.**

* Proven ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

### **About Reducto**


Reducto is the agentic document platform for leading AI teams who demand enterprise performance at scale. We provide a comprehensive toolkit for working with documents the way a human would, combining custom in\-house and leading frontier models to power efficient and accurate document workflows.


We’ve grown rapidly, increasing revenue 8x year over year and partnering with hundreds of companies, from leading AI teams like Harvey, Vanta, and Scale, to enterprise customers across FAANG and top trading firms.


Reducto has raised over $100M from world\-class investors including a16z, Benchmark, and First Round Capital.

As an early member of our GTM team, you'll own our outbound strategy and have the responsibility of generating pipeline during this period of rapid scale. For the right candidate, this role offers a clear path to progress into an Account Executive position as we expand our GTM org.

### **We would love to meet you if the following resonates:**

* **You’re Scrappy:** You're tenacious and creative in finding ways to reach the right customers. You don't just follow playbooks – you write them. We want someone who spots opportunities others miss and isn't afraid to run scrappy experiments to prove out new channels.
* **You Get Technical Buyers:** You have 2\+ years of experience as a BDR or in a Growth role, ideally selling technical products to technical buyers
* **You’re an Exceptional Communicator:** You can speak the language of technical buyers and quickly grasp their needs. You're exceptional at both written and verbal communication.
* **You’re Extremely Organized and Process Oriented:** You’re incredibly organized and follow a strict process to maintain CRM cleanliness and keep track of experiments you’re running and the results.
* **You Know Sales Dev Best Practices:** In short, this isn’t your first rodeo. You’ve tried all the tools, know the messaging best practices and know how to scale an outbound effort without getting your inbox(es) spammed.

### **The core work will include:**


80% of Time

* Building and executing creative outbound campaigns to generate qualified leads
* Setting up and optimizing new lead generation channels through content and marketing experiments


20% of Time

* Building basic sales processes / tracking of efforts in CRM
* Supporting deals from initial contact through to close
* Creating content that resonates with technical decision makers

### **Bonus points if you:**

* Have experience selling ML/AI or developer tools
* Have previously worked at a high\-growth startup
* Bring established relationships in the ML/AI ecosystem
* Have a technical background or strong interest in AI/ML
* Have demonstrated success in previous BDR roles with clear metrics


This is an in person role at our office in NYC. We’re an early stage company which means that the role requires working hard and moving quickly. Please only apply if that excites you.

**About Reducto**
-----------------

*Nearly 80% of enterprise data is in unstructured formats like PDFs*


PDFs are the status quo for enterprise knowledge in nearly every industry. Insurance claims, financial statements, invoices, and health records are all stored in a structure that’s simply impractical for use in digital workflows. This isn’t an inconvenience—it’s a critical bottleneck that leads to dozens of wasted hours every week.

*Traditional approaches fail at reliably extracting information in complex PDFs*


OCR and even more sophisticated ML approaches work for simple text documents but are unreliable for anything more complex. Text from different columns are jumbled together, figures are ignored, and tables are a nightmare to get right. Overcoming this usually requires a large engineering effort dedicated to building specialized pipelines for every document type you work with.

**Reducto** **breaks document layouts into subsections and then contextually parses each depending on the type of content.** This is made possible by a combination of vision models, LLMs, and a suite of heuristics we built over time. Put simply, we can help you:

* Accurately extract text and tables even with nonstandard layouts
* Automatically convert graphs to tabular data and summarize images in documents
* Extract important fields from complex forms with simple, natural language instructions
* Build powerful retrieval pipelines using Reducto’s document metadata
* Intelligently chunk information using the document’s layout data

**Benefits at Reducto**
-----------------------

*At Reducto, we’re invested in the well\-being and growth of our team. Here’s what we currently offer:*

* **Unlimited PTO:** We believe great work requires recharging.
* **Lunch:** Receive a free lunch to eat with your teammates daily at the office
* **Reimbursed Transportation:** Provide us with your receipts and we’ll take care of the costs
* **Insurance**: Generous health insurance covering medical, dental, and vision.
* **Health and Wellness Budget:** We provide up to $150/mo reimbursement for health and wellness spending, such as gym memberships, fitness classes, or similar.
* **Parental Leave:** Work with us to build a leave schedule that works for you and your family
* **401k \+ 4%** company match

jobs.title: SAP Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Syskoplan Reply is a part of the Reply Network, focused on delivering transformative projects to our clients leveraging SAP solutions. Syskoplan Reply is an SAP Gold partner and has recognized expertise executing global projects in various industries and a wide range of competencies including business process consulting, customer experience, intelligent automation, ERP and more.



The Project Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting the administrative functions required to successfully execute a range of SAP technology\-based projects. Working with the Project Manager or on smaller projects individually, the Project Coordinator supports the project plan and is responsible for ensuring accuracy and timeliness of associated project deliverables, including communication of status, risks and issues to the relevant team members. A successful candidate must be extremely organized and can thrive in a fast paced, deadline\-oriented SAP project environment.



### **Responsibilities**

* Maintaining standard project documentation such as project plan, travel plans, team roster, status reports, risks and issue logs, budget reports, presentations etc.
* Support testing coordination and defect management activities within SAP Cloud ALM, including monitoring test progress, logging and prioritizing defects, and following up with teams to drive timely resolution.
* Set up and organization of project document repository
* Recording minutes during project, team, and steering committee meetings and gathering related information for project documentation, storing documentation
* Management of change requests to the project plan and other project management documentation
* Provision of seamless communication, planning business activities with clients and stakeholders
* Schedule and organize project team meetings
* Coordination of third\-party activities in relation to project execution
* Other administrative tasks as assigned

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree with 1\-2 years relevant experience
* Travel up to 50%
* SAP prior knowledge or software implementation experience
* Excellent oral, written and interpersonal communication skills. Must be able to communicate effectively and professionally with external contacts or employees, including senior executives, international and domestic team members
* Organizational and administrative skills to enable the maintenance and storage of electronic project files
* Strong knowledge and experience using the Microsoft Office Suite including competence in advance features of Microsoft Office programs. Detailed knowledge of capabilities of Microsoft Teams and SharePoint or a willingness to gain and maintain such knowledge so it can be applied to the management of projects.
* Manage multiple priorities by using appropriate methodologies and tools. Experience with successfully managing complex project and program delivery
* Ability to understand basic technical conversations in meetings and be able to take notes on the details being discussed

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* SmartSheet experience
* A knowledge of various project methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, SAP Activate) is desirable or willingness to learn


About Reply



Reply specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new communication channels and digital media. Reply is a network of highly specialized companies supporting global industrial groups operating in the telecom and media, industry and services, banking, insurance and public administration sectors in the definition and development of business models enabled for the new paradigms of AI, cloud computing, digital media and the Internet of Things. Reply services include Consulting, System Integration and Digital Services.

The base compensation range for this full\-time position is between $75,000 \- $120,000 plus benefits. Compensation decisions are supported through market data, where regional variances may exist based on cost of labor. We also take into consideration prior experience, relevant skills, education and/or training, certifications and, as applicable, other required qualifications. If you have questions regarding compensation, the talent acquisition team can provide relevant details during the interview process.

Reply is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to provide equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you need assistance and reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, email us at jobusa@reply.com. jobs.description:
RN PROGRAM COORDINATOR – CNA TRAINING PROGRAM

**Job Type:** Part\-Time / Contract  
**Schedule:** Flexible  
**Location:** Atlanta/College Park, Georgia Area  
**Compensation:** Negotiable Monthly Contract Fee

POSITION SUMMARY

A developing **Georgia Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) training program** is seeking an experienced, dependable, and organized **Georgia Registered Nurse (RN)** to serve as **RN Program Coordinator**.

This is a **part\-time/contract opportunity** ideal for an RN with experience in nursing education, CNA training, long\-term care, skilled nursing, or program oversight who is interested in supporting a growing healthcare education program without committing to a traditional full\-time position.

PROGRAM COORDINATOR RESPONSIBILITIES

The RN Program Coordinator will provide professional oversight and assist with maintaining the CNA training program in accordance with applicable **Georgia Department of Community Health (DCH)** requirements.

Responsibilities may include:

* Provide professional RN oversight of the CNA training program.
* Assist with ensuring compliance with applicable Georgia DCH requirements.
* Review curriculum, lesson plans, policies, procedures, and training standards.
* Provide oversight and guidance to CNA instructors.
* Assist with maintaining appropriate instructor and student training documentation.
* Monitor classroom, laboratory, skills, and clinical components for program compliance.
* Assist with evaluation of student clinical and skills competency requirements.
* Participate in program evaluations and quality\-improvement activities.
* Assist with preparation for DCH reviews, surveys, audits, and required program documentation.
* Serve as an RN resource regarding clinical education and appropriate standards of care.
* Help ensure students receive training consistent with approved CNA program requirements.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Current, unrestricted **Georgia Registered Nurse (RN) license**.
* Nursing experience with strong clinical knowledge.
* Strong organizational, leadership, and communication skills.
* Ability to maintain and review regulatory and educational documentation.
* Dependable and able to provide consistent program oversight.
* Passion for educating and developing future healthcare professionals.

TRAIN\-THE\-TRAINER EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

Applicants **must have completed or possess qualifying Train\-the\-Trainer preparation/experience applicable to Georgia nurse aide training requirements.**

Experience as a **CNA/Nurse Aide Program Coordinator, RN Instructor, Staff Development Coordinator, or Nurse Educator** is strongly preferred.

Experience in **long\-term care, skilled nursing, geriatrics, or CNA education** is highly desirable.

COMPENSATION

**Negotiable Monthly Contract Fee**

This is not intended to be a traditional full\-time RN position. Compensation is negotiable based on experience, Train\-the\-Trainer qualifications, previous CNA/Nurse Aide program experience, and the level of ongoing program involvement required. This is a part\-time independent contract opportunity and is not a traditional full\-time RN position.

IDEAL CANDIDATE

We are looking for an RN who understands that CNA education is about more than teaching skills. The right candidate will value **compassion, competence, dignity, professionalism, and excellence** and will help prepare future CNAs to provide quality, person\-centered care.

**Interested candidates should submit a résumé outlining RN experience, nursing education/CNA training experience, and Train\-the\-Trainer qualifications for consideration.**

Pay: $750\.00 \- $2,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Front Desk & Office Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**The front desk is not simply where people arrive. It is where they begin to understand who we are.**


TruOak Financial Partners is growing with purpose. More than 30 financial professionals have joined our firm in 2026; our reach continues to expand across the Southeast, and our workplace has been recognized for leadership, well\-being, and work\-life flexibility. Growth at this pace creates opportunity, but it also requires exceptional people who keep the details, relationships, and daily experience aligned.


We are hiring a **Front Desk \& Office Operations Coordinator** to become the welcoming, dependable center of our Atlanta office. This position combines professional reception, office coordination, administrative support, and special projects. You will be the first point of contact for clients, candidates, partners, and team members while helping the office operate smoothly behind the scenes.


For the right person, this is much more than a traditional front\-desk position. It is an opportunity for a resourceful, relationship\-oriented professional who takes ownership, notices what needs attention, and wants to build a long\-term career with a growing organization. As TruOak grows, the right person can grow in responsibility, capability, and impact with us. **This role includes medical benefits, dental benefits, vision insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan.**

**What Success Looks Like**

Success begins with a simple standard: visitors feel welcomed, informed, and confident in TruOak from the moment they arrive.

* The office remains organized, prepared, and responsive even when priorities change quickly.
* Team members trust that commitments will be handled accurately and completed on time.
* Small issues are noticed early, communicated clearly, and resolved before they become larger problems.
* You become increasingly valuable because you learn the business, strengthen relationships, and take ownership of more over time.

 **Compensation:**
$45,000 \- $55,000

 **Responsibilities:*** **Create an exceptional first impression.** Welcome clients, candidates, partners, vendors, and team members; maintain a polished reception area; and ensure visitor procedures are followed consistently.
* **Manage communication flow.** Answer and route incoming calls and general inquiries, take accurate messages, and ensure requests reach the appropriate person promptly.
* **Coordinate schedules and meeting spaces.** Schedule appointments, manage conference room calendars, prepare meeting areas, and help prevent conflicts.
* **Keep office operations moving.** Manage mail, deliveries, outgoing shipments, office supplies, and routine requests involving building management or service providers.
* **Support meetings, events, and onboarding.** Help prepare materials, workspaces, refreshments, and other logistics for meetings, candidate visits, training sessions, company events, and new team members.
* **Provide administrative support.** Assist staff and leadership with document preparation, scanning, filing, data entry, research, follow\-up, and related assignments requiring accuracy and follow\-through.
* **Protect confidential information.** Handle client, candidate, employee, and business information with sound judgment, discretion, and respect for company procedures.
* **Contribute across the team.** Take on delegated assignments and special projects, adapt when priorities shift, and identify practical ways to improve office processes.

 **Qualifications:*** **Relevant experience.** At least two years of experience in reception, office coordination, administrative support, client service, hospitality, or a comparable professional environment is preferred.
* **Education.** A high school diploma or equivalent is required. An associate degree, bachelor’s degree, or relevant professional training is a plus, not a requirement.
* **Administrative capability.** Comfort using Microsoft Office, Outlook, shared calendars, virtual meeting platforms, and standard office equipment, with the ability to learn new systems quickly.
* **Clear communication.** Strong verbal and written communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to represent the firm professionally with many different audiences.
* **Organization and follow\-through.** Excellent attention to detail, time management, prioritization, and the discipline to close the loop on assignments.
* **Strong team acumen.** A collaborative approach, a willingness to support others, and an understanding that individual success and team success are connected.
* **Flexibility and adaptability.** Comfort with changing priorities, learning new processes, and taking on different responsibilities as the organization grows.
* **Ownership and dependability.** Consistent punctuality, reliable follow\-through, personal accountability, and the initiative to act without requiring constant direction.
* **Relationship orientation.** A natural ability to build trust with colleagues, clients, candidates, partners, and vendors while maintaining appropriate professionalism.
* **Growth mindset.** Openness to coaching, curiosity, and genuine motivation to earn greater responsibility over time.

This role is ideal for a highly organized, detail\-oriented professional who thrives in a fast\-paced research environment and is committed to maintaining the highest standards of data quality, regulatory compliance, and participant care. The successful candidate will play a key role in advancing impactful research while working closely with study participants, families, investigators, and clinical teams.

* Experience administering, scoring, and interpreting standardized cognitive and neuropsychological assessments (psychometrist\-level competency), including strict adherence to standardized administration procedures.
* Skill in abstracting and extracting clinical data from medical records with accuracy and consistency, including chart review for eligibility determination and outcomes data.
* Strong interpersonal skill in interfacing directly with research participants and their families, building rapport while maintaining protocol fidelity and participant comfort throughout study visits.
* Demonstrated track record of managing complex, detail\-intensive clinical research projects with minimal error.
* Ability to handle administrative activities generally associated with the conduct of clinical trials.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:* Manages research project databases, develops flow sheets and other study related documents, and completes source documents/case report forms.
* Provides guidance to less experienced staff.
* Interfaces with research participants, determines eligibility and consents study participants according to protocol.
* Approves orders for supplies and equipment maintenance.
* Assists in developing recruitment strategies and conducting screenings for study participants including interviews and questionnaires.
* Supervises collection of study specimens and processing.
* Establishes case packages for study procedures, monitors scheduling of procedures and charges, coordinates other services as needed.
* Ensures compliance with research protocols, reviews case report forms and audits for accuracy with source documents, attends monitoring meetings with sponsors.
* Prepares regulatory submissions.
* With appropriate credentialing and training may perform phlebotomy or diagnostics.
* Performs related approved responsibilities as required.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:* Prior experience as a psychometrist or in administering/scoring cognitive or neuropsychological test batteries.
* Demonstrated experience extracting and abstracting data from electronic medical records.
* Experience working directly with pediatric or adult patients and family members in a research or clinical setting.
* Exceptional organizational skill and a proven record of high accuracy in detail\-oriented clinical research tasks.

  

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:* High School Diploma or GED and five years of clinical research experience.

**Experience Requirements**

* Experience working with kid consumer products and/or kid\-related business a bonus
* Proven experience in client relationship management and presentation development/delivery
* Project management experience, managing internal stakeholders and clients

* Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to track timelines, prioritize tasks, proactively solve challenges and ensure smooth execution

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Join our team as a Technical Account Manager, where you’ll serve as a trusted resource helping clients get the most out of their software. By developing and maintaining expert\-level knowledge of our products, you’ll support users with thoughtful solutions, guide them through training, and help streamline their operations. From supporting system implementation to building strong client relationships, you'll play a key role in ensuring businesses run smoothly and efficiently. If you enjoy learning, sharing your knowledge, and making a real impact, this role could be a great fit for you!


\*\*\* This position requires flexibility for travel during the second week of employment for training purposes. Training may be conducted locally or at an alternate location based on business needs. Candidates should be prepared and available to travel as required during this time. \*\*\*


What You’ll Do:


* Lead software implementation, configuration, and deployment to ensure clients get the most out of Yardi products.

* Troubleshoot and resolve complex software issues, serving as a trusted technical resource for clients and internal teams.
